h1: IBDP Private Tuition and the Subject Choices Behind It
heroTitle: Choosing Six Diploma Subjects Well in India
heroSubtitle: Most families reach this page after the option form has gone back to school. This one works the other way round: what the six groups really ask, how Mathematics Analysis and Approaches differs from Applications and Interpretation in practice, what degree requirements force, and what a home tutor can still repair when a subject is locked in.
introSummary: IBDP private tuition in India is most useful when it begins at the subject choice rather than after the first bad report, and a home tutor sitting beside a DP1 student can test a choice in a way no brochure can. The Diploma Programme (DP) asks for six subjects drawn from six groups, three or four at Higher Level (HL) and the rest at Standard Level (SL). That decision is usually taken in a few crowded weeks, with half the evidence a family needs. This page sets out how the groups work in a real school timetable, how Mathematics Analysis and Approaches (AA) and Applications and Interpretation (AI) genuinely differ, what university requirements force, a review you can run at your own dining table, and what changes once a choice is fixed.

contentBlocks.heading: How does a subject-selection query in India turn into a shortlist?
contentBlocks.body:
You send a query or book a free consultation, and the first conversation is about the subject list rather than about the tutor. IB Gram asks which board and programme the student is on, which six subjects are on the table, which of them are Higher Level (HL) and which Standard Level (SL), what the school option blocks allow, where you live and which evenings are actually free after school and CAS commitments.

Only then does a shortlist appear. Profiles are verified before they go live, and a match is proposed against the specific decision in front of you rather than against the programme in general. If the open question is Mathematics, the shortlist leans towards teachers who have taught both Analysis and Approaches (AA) and Applications and Interpretation (AI), because a teacher who only knows one of them will quietly recommend the one they know. If the worry is the Economics internal assessment portfolio, the shortlist leans that way instead. A demo or trial session can be arranged before you commit to anything, and if the fit turns out to be wrong you can ask for a different match.

Two things are worth saying plainly at this stage. IBDP private tuition in India cannot overrule a school. The DP coordinator makes the final placement, and a tutor view is evidence you carry into that conversation, not a decision you can take without it. Availability is also conditional: whether a home tutor can hold a weekday evening slot in your part of the city depends on the level, the subject and the schedule, and nobody can promise it before they have looked.

The consultation is also where the honest answer is sometimes that no tuition is needed yet. A student three weeks into DP1 has not sat a single proper assessment. Give the school teaching a little time, gather one marked piece of work in each contested subject, and the same conversation in six weeks will be worth far more than the one you could have today.
items: 1. Send the six-subject list, the HL and SL split, and the school option blocks
2. A consultation covers the degree directions still open and the evidence gathered so far
3. Verified profiles matched to the specific subject decision, not to the Diploma in general
4. A demo or trial session with a shortlisted tutor before any commitment is made
5. A different match arranged if the tutor and the student do not work well together

contentBlocks.heading: Six groups, six subjects, and how the choice really gets made
contentBlocks.body:
The Diploma Programme (DP) is a two-year course, DP1 and DP2, built from six subjects drawn from six groups. Three or four are taken at Higher Level (HL), with 240 recommended teaching hours each, and the rest at Standard Level (SL) with 150 hours. Every subject is graded 1 to 7. Theory of Knowledge (TOK) and the Extended Essay (EE) combine for up to 3 further points, which is why the maximum is 45. Twenty-four points is the minimum for the diploma, subject to the failing conditions the IB publishes, and Creativity, Activity, Service (CAS) has to be completed as well.

That is the structure. Here is how the choice actually gets made. A student is handed an option form with columns built around the timetable and around how many teachers the school has for each subject. A student who wants Physics and Economics both at HL may find them sitting in the same column. A student who wants an arts subject may find it offered in only one block, against the science they also want. So the real question is rarely what would you like. It is what does this grid permit, and which of the permitted combinations suits this particular child. Ask the DP coordinator early whether your school allows the sixth subject to be drawn from another group, because schools differ in what their timetable can carry.

Then there is the part nobody writes on the form. An older sibling took Chemistry and did well, so Chemistry goes down. A friend group decides together in the corridor. A teacher has a reputation and the subject fills up because of it. A parent who studied engineering finds it hard to hear that their child reasons better from data than from algebra. None of this is foolish. None of it is evidence either, and the option form does not distinguish between the two.

There is also a second route few families in India are shown. The IB Career-related Programme (CP) combines at least two DP courses with a career-related study, the CP core, which covers personal and professional skills, service learning, a reflective project and language development, and a career-related qualification from a separate provider. Far fewer schools in India offer the CP than offer the DP, so at most schools it is not an option. For a student with a clear vocational direction who is being pushed into six academic subjects, it is worth one direct question to the coordinator before the form goes back.
items: Three or four subjects at Higher Level, 240 recommended hours each; the rest at 150
Each subject graded 1 to 7; TOK and the Extended Essay add up to 3 points
24 points is the diploma minimum, subject to the failing conditions the IB publishes
CAS must be completed alongside the six subjects and carries no points itself
Ask which option blocks your school runs before you fix a single choice
The Career-related Programme is a separate route, offered by far fewer schools in India

contentBlocks.heading: Mathematics AA or AI: what evidence should decide it?
contentBlocks.body:
Decide it from how the student actually works, not from which name sounds harder in the staff room. DP Mathematics comes in two separate subjects, each available at HL and SL. Analysis and Approaches (AA) is algebraic and proof-heavy. Applications and Interpretation (AI) is modelling and statistics-heavy, with technology used throughout the course rather than wheeled out at the end.

The evidence a family can gather is more ordinary than it sounds. Put an unfamiliar algebraic rearrangement in front of the student and watch what happens in the first two minutes. Does the hand move, or does it stall? Give them a short proof and ask them to say out loud why the second line follows from the first. Then give them a messy table of real data and ask what it suggests and what it does not. Some students light up at the second task and go flat at the third. Some are the reverse, and they are not weaker students, they are different ones. A tutor running this in a trial session is doing nothing clever. They are making the difference visible before the form is signed.

Students heading for engineering or economics degrees are often advised towards AA. That advice is not wrong, but it is not a rule either. The right choice depends on the degree and on the student, and the school DP coordinator makes the final placement whatever the family concludes.

Selection goes wrong in other groups too, and usually for the same reason. In Studies in Language and Literature, families pick between English A Language and Literature and English A Literature on the basis of the title. What separates them is the work: Paper 1 is guided textual analysis of unseen passages, one at SL and two at HL; Paper 2 is a comparative essay on two studied works; the Individual Oral runs 15 minutes, a 10-minute analysis linked to a global issue followed by 5 minutes of questions; HL students also write an HL essay of 1,200 to 1,500 words, and a learner portfolio is required though not directly assessed. In Economics, the four units are Introduction to economics, Microeconomics, Macroeconomics and The global economy; Paper 1 is extended response, Paper 2 is data response, and Paper 3, the policy paper, is HL only. The internal assessment is a portfolio of three commentaries of up to 800 words each, every one on a published news article, each drawing on a different unit and a different one of the nine key concepts. A student who dislikes writing to a word limit should know all of that before choosing Economics, not in DP2.
items: AA is algebraic and proof-heavy; AI is modelling and statistics-heavy with technology throughout
Both AA and AI are available at Higher Level and at Standard Level
Test the choice on three tasks: a rearrangement, a short proof, a messy data table
English A splits into Language and Literature and Literature, assessed through different work
Economics Paper 3, the policy paper, is Higher Level only and shapes that HL decision
The Economics portfolio is three commentaries of up to 800 words on published news articles

contentBlocks.heading: Subject-choice help and home tuition across India, region by region
contentBlocks.body:
Where you live changes how a subject-selection review gets arranged, not what it concludes. In the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, families in Bandra, Juhu, Worli and Lower Parel usually have a reasonable pool within a short radius, so a home tutor can come for a single diagnostic session and return once more before the form is due. Powai and Andheri work well on weekday evenings if the slot is late enough to clear school and activities. Across the creek, Navi Mumbai, Vashi, Kharghar and Thane are a different calculation, and evening traffic on the corridors into those suburbs can stretch what looks like a short trip on a map, so families there often run the first review online and keep home sessions for the subject that is actually chosen. That is the practical shape of IBDP private tuition in Mumbai for most households.

Bengaluru splits along the same lines. Whitefield, Sarjapur Road and Electronic City sit far enough from Indiranagar, Koramangala and Jayanagar that a tutor living in one rarely holds a fixed weekday slot in the other. HSR Layout, Hebbal, Yelahanka and Kanakapura Road each have their own small pools. IBDP private tuition in Bangalore is often arranged as a hybrid week for exactly this reason. In Pune, Koregaon Park, Kalyani Nagar and Viman Nagar are straightforward for home visits, while Baner, Balewadi, Aundh, Wakad and Hinjewadi form a second cluster and Kharadi a third, and a tutor will usually work within one of them rather than across all three.

In Gujarat the pattern is concentration. Ahmedabad holds most of the supply, around Satellite, Bodakdev and the SG Highway stretch, with Gandhinagar close enough to share it. Families in Surat, Vadodara and Rajkot have fewer local DP specialists and reach further, which is why IBDP private tuition in Ahmedabad is frequently arranged for a student who does not live in Ahmedabad at all. Kolkata and eastern India runs the same way: Salt Lake, New Town, Ballygunge, Alipore and Rajarhat carry the local capacity, while families in Bhubaneswar, Guwahati, Ranchi and Patna usually start online and add home classes when someone suitable turns up nearby.

The same divide appears in Delhi NCR, in Hyderabad and in Chennai: a dense core, a ring of newer suburbs, and a real difference in what a weekday evening can hold between the two. Parents searching for IBDP private tuition in Delhi, IBDP private tuition in Hyderabad, IBDP private tuition in Chennai, IBDP private tuition in Pune or IBDP private tuition in Kolkata are all running into the same geography problem in different clothes.
items: Mumbai Metropolitan Region: Bandra, Juhu, Powai, Andheri, Worli, Navi Mumbai, Vashi, Thane, Kharghar
Bengaluru: Whitefield, Sarjapur Road, Indiranagar, Koramangala, HSR Layout, Hebbal, Yelahanka, Electronic City
Pune: Koregaon Park, Kalyani Nagar, Baner, Balewadi, Hinjewadi, Kharadi, Viman Nagar, Aundh, Wakad
Gujarat: Ahmedabad, Satellite, Bodakdev, SG Highway, Gandhinagar, and further out Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot
Kolkata and eastern India: Salt Lake, New Town, Ballygunge, Alipore, Rajarhat, Bhubaneswar, Guwahati, Ranchi, Patna
Searches for IBDP tuition near me thin out fast outside Delhi NCR, Hyderabad and Chennai

contentBlocks.heading: When the school calendar in India forces the decision
contentBlocks.body:
The Indian academic year runs roughly April to March, and schools in India overwhelmingly enter DP candidates for the May examination session, with results released in early July. Work backwards from that and the subject-selection window becomes obvious. The option form usually circulates while the student is still finishing the year below, taster sessions happen in the same crowded weeks, and the form goes back before anyone has seen a single DP assessment. That is the structural problem: the decision is due before the evidence exists. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school named here, the International Baccalaureate, Cambridge International Education or Pearson Edexcel.

International schools in India handle that window differently, and it is worth knowing which kind yours is. Some run a genuine trial fortnight with real DP material. Some hand out a form with a deadline and a short assembly. Some allow a change in the first weeks of DP1 and say so openly; others allow it in principle while the timetable makes it almost impossible in practice. Ask the coordinator three specific questions: how long is the change window, what happens to the work already missed, and which combinations have actually been permitted in previous cohorts. Written answers are better than corridor ones.

The second calendar pressure lands later. Once DP1 is running, internal assessment deadlines, the Extended Essay timeline, TOK work and CAS commitments start to stack, and each of those is easier or harder depending on the six subjects chosen months earlier. A student with three essay-heavy Higher Levels meets three long pieces of writing in the same term. A student with two laboratory sciences meets a different kind of crowding. Nobody can see this on the option form, which lists subjects rather than workloads.

This is why families arrange home tuition earliest in the weeks around the option deadline, and again in the term after DP1 begins. Those are the two moments when a choice can still be tested against real work rather than against a description in a handbook, and both of them are short.
items: The Indian school year runs roughly April to March; most DP candidates sit the May session
May results are released in early July, which fixes everything that comes before
Option forms usually close before the student has sat any DP assessment at all
Ask the coordinator in writing how long the change window stays open
Essay-heavy and laboratory-heavy combinations crowd different terms in different ways

contentBlocks.heading: Home classes, online or hybrid for testing a subject choice?
contentBlocks.body:
For a subject-selection review specifically, home classes usually win the first session and online usually wins everything after it. The reason is narrow. In a first diagnostic session the tutor is watching the student work, and a good deal of what they need to see happens on paper: where the pencil stops, whether a rearrangement is attempted at all, how a diagram is laid out, whether the student rereads their own sentence. A home tutor sitting at the same table sees all of that at once. A camera pointed at a page sees some of it, later.

Online earns its place on reach. The teacher who has taught both Mathematics AA and AI, or who has marked Economics portfolios, may simply not live in your city. For a family in Guwahati, Ranchi or Surat, waiting for that person to appear locally is not a plan. Online also handles the short follow-up well: a twenty-minute conversation about one marked piece of work does not need anybody to cross a city in the evening.

Hybrid is what most families in India settle into once the choice is made and ordinary tuition begins. One home session a week for the work that has to be watched, one online session for review and question practice, and the arrangement survives a monsoon week, an examination fortnight and a tutor who moves house. It also keeps the weekly cost of travel time down to something sustainable, and that cost is paid in the student sleep schedule rather than in fees.

Be honest about where each one fails. Home classes fail when the only free evening slot is late and the student is already finished for the day, because a tired DP1 student at nine in the evening is not producing evidence about anything. Online fails when the student will not write during the session and the tutor has no way to insist. Hybrid fails when nobody decides what belongs in which session, and both halves turn into the same lesson delivered twice.
items: Home classes are strongest for the first diagnostic session, where paper working is the evidence
Online reaches a teacher who has taught both Mathematics routes but lives in another city
Hybrid splits the week: one home session to watch work, one online for review
A late home session with an exhausted student produces no useful evidence at all
Decide in advance what belongs in the home session and what belongs online

contentBlocks.heading: What should you check before anyone advises on six subjects in India?
contentBlocks.body:
Check that the person advising has actually taught the subjects they are steering your child towards, and at the level in question. That single check removes most bad advice. A tutor who has taught Mathematics Applications and Interpretation as well as Analysis and Approaches can describe what a week in each actually looks like. A tutor who has only taught one of them will describe the other from hearsay, and hearsay in this decision is expensive, because the student lives with the result for two years.

IB Gram verifies profiles before they go live, which covers identity and the claims a tutor makes about qualifications and teaching experience. What a platform cannot see is the part you can. Ask directly which DP subjects the tutor has taught and for how long, at HL or SL or both, and what the last student they taught in that subject found hardest. Ask what they would need to see before recommending AA over AI. A tutor who answers that with a general statement about mathematics rather than with a description of student work has told you something useful.

Then check the boundary. A tutor advising on subject selection is offering evidence and a reading of that evidence. They are not placing the student, they do not sit on the school timetable committee, and they have no standing to tell you a combination will be allowed. Any adviser who talks as though they can arrange the placement is either confused or overselling. The DP coordinator makes the final placement, and the useful tutor is the one who helps you prepare for that meeting rather than one who claims to bypass it.

Finally, check the trial. A demo or trial session before committing is not a formality here. Watch whether the tutor spends the session talking or spends it listening and marking. For a subject-selection review, a tutor who does most of the talking has run the wrong session, however good the talking was.
items: Ask which DP subjects the tutor has taught, at which level, and for how long
Ask what evidence they would need before recommending one Mathematics route over the other
Verified profiles cover identity and claimed experience; subject fit is still yours to judge
No tutor can arrange a placement; the DP coordinator decides which combination the school runs
Use the trial session to see whether the tutor listens and marks or mainly talks

contentBlocks.heading: Degree requirements and the squeeze they put on six choices in India
contentBlocks.body:
Degree requirements are the single largest distorting force on DP subject selection in India, and most of that pressure comes from requirements nobody has actually read. A cousin says engineering needs Higher Level Mathematics. An advertisement says medicine needs two Higher Level sciences. A senior in the year above repeats what they were told. By the time the option form arrives, a family has built a subject list out of secondhand rules for a degree the student has not yet chosen.

The fix is unglamorous. Open the admissions page for one named course at each of the two or three institutions the student would genuinely consider, and write down what those pages actually ask for. Requirements differ by country, by university and by course within the same university, and they change between years. A subject named as required on one page may be listed as merely preferred on another. Where a page names Mathematics Analysis and Approaches specifically, that is a fact about that course rather than a general rule about the DP, and it is exactly the kind of fact worth carrying into the coordinator meeting.

Here is a review a family can run over one weekend, before anybody is hired.

1. List the two or three degree directions still genuinely open, and stop there. A list of seven directions is a decision not yet made, and it will push the student into hedging every group.

2. Open the admissions page for one named course in each direction, and write down the subject and the level each one states.

3. Collect evidence for every contested subject: one marked piece of work, the teacher comment that came with it, and what the student says about the last three weeks of lessons in that subject.

4. Lay the school option grid beside that list and mark every combination the timetable actually permits.

5. Take the surviving shortlist to the DP coordinator with the evidence attached, and ask which placement the school would support and why.

Hedging deserves its own warning. A student who keeps every door open ends up with three Higher Levels they are lukewarm about, and lukewarm at Higher Level over two years is heavier to carry than committed at Higher Level. Closing one door deliberately is often the choice that saves the diploma.
items: Read the admissions page for a named course; do not rely on what a relative remembers
Requirements differ by country, by university and by course, and they change between years
Gather one marked piece of work per contested subject before the family argues about it
Mark which combinations the school option grid actually permits before shortlisting any
Hedging across every direction produces three Higher Levels nobody is committed to

contentBlocks.heading: What can IBDP private tuition in India fix once a choice is locked in?
contentBlocks.body:
It can fix the gap between the student and the subject. It cannot fix the subject. That distinction decides whether the next six months are useful or merely expensive, and it is worth being blunt about which case you are in before you start paying for anything.

Some locked-in choices are not really wrong, they are unfamiliar. A student placed in Mathematics Analysis and Approaches who has never been taught to write a proof is not in the wrong subject; they are missing a skill nobody taught them, and skills can be taught. A student who took Economics without realising the internal assessment is three written commentaries needs writing support and a work plan, not a different subject. In both cases IBDP private tuition in India does exactly what it should: it names the missing skill, builds it in the open, and hands the work back to the student.

Some choices are genuinely wrong, and the honest reading is different. A student who dreads a subject every week, whose marked work shows the same failure repeating after real effort, and who has no degree reason to be there, is telling you something that more sessions will not change. Then the conversation belongs with the coordinator, and it belongs there early, because a change costs missed content and that cost grows every week. Ask what the school will permit, what would have to be caught up, and by when. A tutor can help the student catch up if a change is allowed, which is a real and useful role, but the school decides whether it is allowed at all.

On timelines, be realistic. A missing skill shows movement within a few weeks in the quality of the working rather than in a grade. A rebuilt approach to a whole subject takes a term to show. No tutor can guarantee a grade, and anyone who frames a subject change as a guaranteed recovery is selling rather than advising. Ask instead for a review conversation every few weeks, with the marked work on the table between you.
items: Missing skills can be taught; a genuine mismatch between student and subject cannot
A student dreading one subject weekly after real effort is giving you evidence, not a mood
A change costs missed content, and that cost grows every week the decision is delayed
Expect better working within weeks; expect a changed grade to take considerably longer
Ask for a review every few weeks with the student marked work actually on the table

contentBlocks.heading: Starting IBDP private tuition in India with the option form in front of you
contentBlocks.body:
Bring three things to the first conversation and it will be worth twice as much. The first is the actual list: six subjects, which ones are at Higher Level, and which are still contested. The second is evidence, meaning one or two marked pieces of work in each contested subject with the teacher comments left on. The third is the school option grid, however untidy the photocopy, because half the combinations a family discusses are not available anyway and finding that out early saves an argument.

The first session then has a job rather than a topic. In a subject-selection review, a good tutor spends most of it watching the student work on short tasks chosen to separate the real question, and the last stretch explaining what they saw, in front of the student rather than about them. You should leave with a written view you can take to the DP coordinator, including the case against the recommendation. If the tutor cannot state the case against their own advice, the advice is thin.

If the choices are already fixed and you are past this stage, the first session looks different. It starts with the most recent marked work, finds the specific skill that is missing, and sets one piece of practice for the week. That is all it should do. Nobody should be handed a six-month plan in the first hour.

What happens when you enquire about IBDP private tuition in India is simple enough to state. You describe the board, the programme, the subjects and levels, the school calendar, your locality and the evenings that are free. A shortlist of verified profiles comes back, subject to availability in your area. A demo or trial session can be arranged before you commit, home tuition or online lessons or a hybrid week is set up around the school timetable, and if the fit is wrong you ask for a different match. Nothing about that process depends on you having decided anything first.
items: Bring the six-subject list with the Higher Level split and the contested subjects marked
Bring one or two marked pieces of work per contested subject, teacher comments intact
Bring a photograph of the school option grid, however untidy it looks
Expect a written view you can take to the coordinator, including the case against it
A trial session can be arranged before you commit, subject to tutor availability

faqs.question: Can my child change an IB Diploma subject after DP1 has started?
faqs.answer: Sometimes, and only the school can tell you. Change windows differ from school to school, and the timetable often decides more than the written policy does. Ask the DP coordinator three things in writing: how long the window stays open, what content would have to be caught up, and which combinations the option grid actually permits. The cost of a change is the content already missed, and that cost grows every week, so raise it the moment you suspect it rather than after the first report arrives.

faqs.question: Is Mathematics Analysis and Approaches always the safer choice for engineering?
faqs.answer: No. Students heading for engineering or economics degrees are often advised towards Analysis and Approaches, and that advice is frequently right, but it is not a rule. The correct choice depends on the specific degree and on the student, and the school DP coordinator makes the final placement. Open the admissions page of one named engineering course the student would genuinely apply to and read what it states. Then look at how your child handles algebraic manipulation and proof against how they handle real data, and let both pieces of evidence count.

faqs.question: Can a home tutor help us choose subjects before DP1 even begins?
faqs.answer: Yes, and this is when a home tutor is most useful in the whole two years. A single diagnostic session with short tasks in each contested subject tells you more than weeks of family discussion, because the tutor watches the student work rather than asking what they would prefer. Bring the school option grid and any marked work from the year below. What you should come away with is a written view to take to the coordinator, not a decision, since the school makes the placement itself.

faqs.question: We are in Powai and the school run already eats the evening. Do home tuition slots really work on weekdays?
faqs.answer: Often yes in Powai and Andheri, where the local pool is reasonable, but the slot has to be late enough to clear school and activities and early enough that the student is still awake. A tired DP1 student at nine in the evening will not produce useful work. Families across the creek in Vashi, Kharghar or Thane usually find weekday evening home sessions harder, since evening traffic on those corridors can stretch a short trip, and they run the first review online instead.

faqs.question: What is the Career-related Programme, and should we look at it?
faqs.answer: The IB Career-related Programme combines at least two Diploma Programme courses with a career-related study, the CP core covering personal and professional skills, service learning, a reflective project and language development, and a career-related qualification from a separate provider. Far fewer schools in India offer it than offer the DP, so at most schools it will not be available at all. It is still worth one question to the coordinator if your child has a clear vocational direction and is being steered into six academic subjects only because everyone else is.

faqs.question: The school placed my child in a subject the timetable decided, not the student. What now?
faqs.answer: Start by separating unfamiliar from wrong. A subject that feels alien in the first month is usually a missing skill, and skills can be taught, which is precisely what private tuition is for. A subject that produces the same failure after real sustained effort, with no degree reason to continue, is a different problem and belongs in a conversation with the coordinator rather than with a tutor. Gather two marked pieces of work first, because a request supported by evidence is treated very differently from a complaint.

faqs.question: How many subjects can one family realistically arrange tuition for at once?
faqs.answer: Fewer than most families start with. A DP student already carries six subjects, CAS, the Extended Essay and Theory of Knowledge, so every tuition hour is taken from somewhere else. Two subjects is usually workable. Three is heavy, and only sensible for a short stretch with a clear end date. Beyond that, tuition starts competing with the school work it is meant to support, and the student stops doing independent practice altogether, which is the thing that actually moves marks.

faqs.question: Does online tuition work for a subject-selection review, or must it be in person?
faqs.answer: It works, with one caveat. The first diagnostic session benefits from someone at the same table, because a good deal of the evidence is on paper: where the pencil stops, whether a rearrangement is attempted, how a diagram is laid out. If nobody suitable is reachable locally, which is common in Surat, Guwahati or Bhubaneswar, run it online with a document camera or a phone propped over the page, and ask the student to keep writing throughout. Follow-up conversations are fine online in every case.

faqs.question: Should a parent sit in on a home session when the subject choice is being discussed?
faqs.answer: For the review session, yes, for the last part of it. You need to hear the reasoning and not only the conclusion, because a recommendation you cannot repeat is a recommendation you cannot defend at the coordinator meeting. For the working part of the session, stay out of the room, since a fifteen or sixteen year old will perform for a parent rather than think. For ordinary subject tuition afterwards, a short conversation at the end of each month is plenty.

faqs.question: What does IBDP private tuition cost in India?
faqs.answer: No honest page can quote you a figure, because it moves with the subject, the level, the city, whether the tutor travels to you, and how many sessions a week you take. What you can do is compare like with like. Ask for the rate per session rather than per month, ask whether travel is included for home visits, ask what happens to a session cancelled at short notice, and ask whether marking between sessions is included. Those four answers make two quotes comparable.

faqs.question: Our school in Ahmedabad offers a narrow subject list. What are the options?
faqs.answer: Work with the grid you have, and get the constraint in writing. Ask the coordinator which combinations have actually run in previous cohorts, because a subject printed in the handbook is not always timetabled. If the subject your child needs for a named degree course genuinely is not offered, that changes the conversation from tutoring to school choice, and it is far better to know that in Grade 10 than in DP2. Families in Gandhinagar, Surat and Vadodara meet this more often than families in Satellite or Bodakdev.

faqs.question: How soon should we see something change after tuition starts?
faqs.answer: Look at the working rather than the grade for the first several weeks. A missing skill such as algebraic rearrangement or structuring a commentary shows up quickly in how the student sets out an answer, long before a mark moves. A whole subject approach being rebuilt takes about a term. No tutor can guarantee a grade, and any plan that promises one should be read as a warning sign. Ask for a short review every few weeks with the marked work actually on the table.

Gather two marked pieces of work first, because a request supported by evidence is treated very differently from a complaint.

mainEntity.name: How many subjects can one family realistically arrange tuition for at once?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fewer than most families start with. A DP student already carries six subjects, CAS, the Extended Essay and Theory of Knowledge, so every tuition hour is taken from somewhere else. Two subjects is usually workable. Three is heavy, and only sensible for a short stretch with a clear end date. Beyond that, tuition starts competing with the school work it is meant to support, and the student stops doing independent practice altogether, which is the thing that actually moves marks.

mainEntity.name: Does online tuition work for a subject-selection review, or must it be in person?

acceptedAnswer.text: It works, with one caveat. The first diagnostic session benefits from someone at the same table, because a good deal of the evidence is on paper: where the pencil stops, whether a rearrangement is attempted, how a diagram is laid out. If nobody suitable is reachable locally, which is common in Surat, Guwahati or Bhubaneswar, run it online with a document camera or a phone propped over the page, and ask the student to keep writing throughout. Follow-up conversations are fine online in every case.

mainEntity.name: Should a parent sit in on a home session when the subject choice is being discussed?

acceptedAnswer.text: For the review session, yes, for the last part of it. You need to hear the reasoning and not only the conclusion, because a recommendation you cannot repeat is a recommendation you cannot defend at the coordinator meeting. For the working part of the session, stay out of the room, since a fifteen or sixteen year old will perform for a parent rather than think. For ordinary subject tuition afterwards, a short conversation at the end of each month is plenty.

mainEntity.name: What does IBDP private tuition cost in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: No honest page can quote you a figure, because it moves with the subject, the level, the city, whether the tutor travels to you, and how many sessions a week you take. What you can do is compare like with like. Ask for the rate per session rather than per month, ask whether travel is included for home visits, ask what happens to a session cancelled at short notice, and ask whether marking between sessions is included. Those four answers make two quotes comparable.

mainEntity.name: Our school in Ahmedabad offers a narrow subject list. What are the options?

acceptedAnswer.text: Work with the grid you have, and get the constraint in writing. Ask the coordinator which combinations have actually run in previous cohorts, because a subject printed in the handbook is not always timetabled. If the subject your child needs for a named degree course genuinely is not offered, that changes the conversation from tutoring to school choice, and it is far better to know that in Grade 10 than in DP2. Families in Gandhinagar, Surat and Vadodara meet this more often than families in Satellite or Bodakdev.

mainEntity.name: How soon should we see something change after tuition starts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look at the working rather than the grade for the first several weeks. A missing skill such as algebraic rearrangement or structuring a commentary shows up quickly in how the student sets out an answer, long before a mark moves. A whole subject approach being rebuilt takes about a term. No tutor can guarantee a grade, and any plan that promises one should be read as a warning sign. Ask for a short review every few weeks with the marked work actually on the table.

finalCta: Send the six-subject list and a photograph of the school option grid, or book a free consultation. IB Gram asks about the programme, the levels, the school calendar, your locality and free evenings, then shortlists verified tutors, subject to availability. A trial session can be arranged before you commit, IBDP private tuition in India runs at home, online or hybrid, and you can ask for a different match if the fit is wrong.

A centre buys you structure and a lower cost per hour. A school teacher knows your timetable from the inside. A freelance tutor is the most flexible to arrange. The trade-off that usually decides it is independence against convenience.

h1: IBDP Online Tutors for Higher Level Subjects Few Teach
heroTitle: Higher Level DP subjects, taught online across India
heroSubtitle: Three Higher Levels sit at the centre of a Diploma Programme result, and in most Indian cities only a handful of people teach any one of them properly. This page is about finding that person online: how to search, what to make the trial prove, and what you give up.
introSummary: IBDP online tutors in India are, for most families, the only realistic route to a specialist in a Higher Level subject that nobody nearby teaches. The scarcity is specific rather than general. Mathematics Analysis and Approaches (AA) at Higher Level (HL), Physics HL, Economics HL and English A at HL are the four courses that empty a local tutor list fastest, because each adds content or a whole component that the Standard Level (SL) course does not have. A tutor who is strong with SL Mathematics can still be the wrong person for an AA HL proof question. So the search widens: first across your city, then to online supply from anywhere in the country. What follows is how to find such a tutor, what the trial lesson must test, and when your child does not need one at all.

contentBlocks.heading: How does a Higher Level request in India reach a tutor who teaches it?
contentBlocks.body:
You send a query naming the subject, the level and the actual problem, and the matching works outwards from there. IB Gram asks about board, syllabus, level, school calendar, location and schedule, shortlists tutors whose profiles are verified against those needs, and a demo or trial session can be arranged before you commit. If the fit turns out wrong afterwards, you can ask for a different match.

Level is the detail families leave out, and it is the one that decides everything else. In the Diploma Programme (DP), Mathematics splits into Analysis and Approaches (AA) and Applications and Interpretation (AI), each offered at Higher Level (HL) and at Standard Level (SL). That is four separate courses and four separate tutor pools, and the thinnest of them is AA HL. A query that says "Maths tutor for Class 11" produces a long, useless list. A query that says "Mathematics AA HL, DP1, proof by induction and the binomial theorem, school mock in January" produces a short list you can act on that same week.

State the deadline as well. A DP2 family in Kochi writing in October is planning against a May session that is already close, so sessions will be paper-led and long. A DP1 family in Chandigarh writing in July has eighteen months and should be building the HL foundation instead of drilling papers. Same subject, different tutor, different session length, different weekly rhythm.

One warning about speed. A scarce HL specialist is not sitting idle waiting for a query, so matching for AA HL or Economics HL usually takes longer than matching for an SL subject, and availability is always subject to the tutor's existing timetable. If you need a weekday evening slot after school and activities, say so in the first message rather than discovering the clash at the trial.
items: 1. Name the subject, the level and the paper or component going wrong.
2. Say which exam session the student is entered for and when mocks fall.
3. Give your city and the evening windows that are genuinely free.
4. Read shortlisted profiles for HL teaching, not general subject experience.
5. Book a trial built on the student's own marked work, then decide.

contentBlocks.heading: Three Higher Levels, 240 hours each: what the DP asks of a student in India
contentBlocks.body:
The Diploma Programme runs over two years, DP1 and DP2, and a student takes six subjects from six groups. Three or four of those sit at Higher Level, with 240 recommended teaching hours each; the rest are Standard Level at 150 hours. Every subject is graded 1 to 7. Theory of Knowledge (TOK) and the Extended Essay (EE) together contribute up to 3 further points, which is how 45 becomes the maximum, and 24 is the minimum for the diploma, subject to the IB's failing conditions. Creativity, Activity, Service (CAS) has to be completed alongside all of it.

Ninety extra hours per subject is not a rounding difference. It is a different course, with its own content and, in several subjects, its own components. That is precisely where the tutor scarcity comes from. Someone who has taught SL for years may never have taught the Additional Higher Level (AHL) material in a science, never prepared a student for an Economics Paper 3, never marked a response to two unseen passages in a Paper 1.

Multiply that by three and the arithmetic gets uncomfortable. A student carrying Physics HL, Mathematics AA HL and Economics HL is holding 720 recommended teaching hours across three of the least-taught courses in the country. In Bengaluru or Delhi NCR a family might find someone locally for one of them. For the other two, IBDP online tutors in India are usually the only pool deep enough to hold a genuine specialist.

Which Higher Levels a student carries also changes how tuition should be spread. All three cannot be tutored at once without the week collapsing. Pick the one where a point is most gettable, hold it until the work is stable, and leave the others to school teaching and independent practice until that first subject has settled.
items: Three or four Higher Levels at 240 recommended hours; Standard Level runs to 150
Every subject graded 1 to 7, with 24 the minimum for the diploma
TOK and the Extended Essay contribute up to 3 points towards 45
CAS must be completed alongside, and it takes real weekday time
HL adds content and, in some subjects, an extra paper or essay

contentBlocks.heading: Which Higher Level subjects are hardest to staff in India?
contentBlocks.body:
Four of them, consistently: Mathematics Analysis and Approaches HL, Physics HL, Economics HL and English A at Higher Level. Each is scarce for a different reason, and knowing the reason tells you what to look for in a tutor instead of assuming a subject degree settles the matter.

Mathematics AA HL is algebraic and proof-heavy, where AI is modelling and statistics with technology used throughout. A tutor who is comfortable with AI HL statistics can be out of their depth in an AA HL proof. Students heading for engineering or economics degrees are often advised towards AA, though the right choice depends on the degree and the student, and the school's DP coordinator makes the final placement. Once that placement is locked, the tutor has to match the course rather than the subject name.

Physics HL carries the Additional Higher Level content on top of an assessment structure it shares with SL. Since first assessment in 2025 the sciences have Paper 1 in two parts, 1A multiple choice and 1B data-based questions, and Paper 2 with short-answer and extended-response questions. The internal assessment is the scientific investigation, worth 20%, marked on Research design, Data analysis, Conclusion and Evaluation at 6 marks each, within a maximum of 3,000 words. Students may investigate in groups of up to three, but each writes an individual report.

Economics HL has a component that does not exist at SL at all: Paper 3, the policy paper, sitting beside Paper 1's extended response and Paper 2's data response. It is the paper students underprepare for most. English A at HL adds a second unseen passage in Paper 1 and the HL essay of 1,200 to 1,500 words, neither of which an SL teacher has ever had to coach a student through.
items: Mathematics AA HL: proof and algebra, not modelling with technology throughout
Physics HL: Additional Higher Level content above the shared paper structure
Economics HL: Paper 3, the policy paper, which SL students never sit
English A HL: two unseen passages in Paper 1, plus the HL essay
The scientific investigation: 20% of the grade, four criteria of 6 marks

contentBlocks.heading: IBDP online tutors in India: where Higher Level supply runs out
contentBlocks.body:
Higher Level teaching capacity follows the IB schools, and those schools cluster. Delhi NCR, the Mumbai Metropolitan Region around Powai and Bandra, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai and Pune between them hold most of the country's experienced DP teachers. Even inside those six the supply is lumpy. A family in Whitefield may find three people who list Physics on a profile and none who has taught the Additional Higher Level topics to exam, and a family in Gachibowli or Koregaon Park can hit the same wall.

Move outside them and the problem changes shape rather than degree. In southern India beyond Bengaluru and Chennai, households in Kochi, Coimbatore, Thiruvananthapuram, Mysuru, Mangaluru, Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada and Madurai are often the only DP family in their immediate locality. Across central and western India the same holds for Indore, Bhopal, Nagpur, Raipur, Jabalpur, Nashik, Aurangabad and Goa. A local SL Mathematics tutor exists in all of these places. An AA HL tutor generally does not.

In Kolkata and eastern India, families in Salt Lake, New Town, Ballygunge, Alipore and Rajarhat have more to choose from than those in Bhubaneswar, Guwahati, Ranchi or Patna, but the HL gap shows up in every one of them. Across northern India beyond Delhi NCR, Chandigarh, Mohali, Panchkula, Jaipur, Lucknow, Dehradun, Amritsar, Ludhiana and Kanpur have growing IB intakes and thin HL supply. In Gujarat, the Satellite, Bodakdev and SG Highway pockets of Ahmedabad, along with Gandhinagar, Surat, Vadodara and Rajkot, sit in exactly that position.

This is the whole argument for the mode. An IBDP online tutor in Mumbai can teach a DP2 student in Raipur on a Tuesday evening and a DP1 student in Madurai on a Thursday. Searching for an online IBDP tutor near me and finding nothing is not a failed search; it is an accurate reading of local supply.
items: Bengaluru, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Chennai and Pune hold most DP teaching capacity
Kochi, Coimbatore and Visakhapatnam: SL tutors locally, HL specialists rarely
Indore, Bhopal, Nagpur and Raipur often have one DP household per locality
Salt Lake and New Town offer more choice than Guwahati, Ranchi or Patna
Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Surat and Vadodara: growing IB intake, thin HL supply

contentBlocks.heading: Higher Level deadlines against the May session calendar in India
contentBlocks.body:
Exam sessions run in May and November, and schools in India overwhelmingly enter candidates for the May session. That fits the Indian academic year, which runs roughly April to March, and it means a DP2 year ends with results released in early July. Everything a Higher Level tutor does is planned backwards from those two dates. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school, the International Baccalaureate, Cambridge International Education or Pearson Edexcel.

International schools here run their own mock cycles, usually through the DP2 winter, and those mocks feed the predicted grades that university applications rely on. For an HL subject this is the pinch point. The extra content is often still being taught while the mocks are being sat, so a student can walk into a Physics HL mock having never been formally taught two of the Additional Higher Level topics on the paper. The mark that comes back then reads as a collapse when it is really a coverage gap.

The coursework calendar stacks on top of that. A scientific investigation, an Economics portfolio of three commentaries, an English HL essay, the Extended Essay and TOK all carry internal deadlines set by the school, and they rarely spread themselves politely across the year. October to December of DP2 is when many families discover that three Higher Levels and the core were never going to fit into one term.

So ask the school for its deadline sheet at the start of the year and hand it to the tutor in week one. A tutor working to the real dates front-loads the HL content the mocks will test and then shifts to papers. A tutor working from a generic plan teaches the right thing two months late. And if a November session is being discussed for any reason, ask the DP coordinator what that would involve before booking anything at all.
items: The May session dominates in India; results are released in early July
The academic year runs roughly April to March, so DP2 closes in spring
DP2 mock cycles fall in winter and feed the predicted grades
Ask the school for its internal coursework deadline sheet in week one
Additional Higher Level content is often still being taught during mocks

contentBlocks.heading: Home, online or hybrid for a two-hour Higher Level session?
contentBlocks.body:
Online wins on supply, home wins on attention, and hybrid is what most Higher Level families settle into by the middle of DP1. If the subject is scarce, supply decides the question before anything else does: a home tutor who has not taught the course is not an option, whatever else is in their favour.

What a home tutor gives you at HL is the thing a screen handles worst. Sitting beside a student, a home tutor watches a derivation being written in real time, catches the line where a sign flips, and notices a diagram being copied without the axes being understood. Home tuition is also harder to skip. Nobody quietly turns a camera off during home classes, and for a tired DP2 student in December that matters more than it sounds.

What online gives you is the person who has actually taught Mathematics AA HL for years. That is not a small trade. A tutor with a graphics tablet, a decent document camera and the habit of making the student write and share working can close most of the gap, though not all of it. The honest limits: reading a student's face is harder, a student can look engaged and be completely lost, and an unstable connection during a long derivation costs real teaching time rather than a minute of chat.

Hybrid is the sensible compromise wherever it is available. A local home tutor holds the SL subjects and the study habits in person, while the HL specialist runs online once or twice a week. Some families in Pune and Ahmedabad do the reverse: an online HL tutor through the term, with home sessions booked intensively in the weeks before mocks. IBDP online classes are not an all-or-nothing choice, and the mix should change as the year does.
items: Home tuition catches errors in written working that a screen hides
Online reaches the HL specialist who does not live in your city
Hybrid: online HL sessions weekly, home sessions through the mock run-up
A tutor who has never taught the HL course is not an option
Long derivations suffer most from an unstable connection

contentBlocks.heading: How do you check an HL specialist's depth before you pay?
contentBlocks.body:
You ask questions only someone who has taught the Higher Level course can answer, and you ask them before the trial rather than after it. Profiles are verified before they go live and matching asks about board, syllabus, level, school calendar, location and schedule, but the subject-depth check belongs to you, because only you know which topic your child is stuck on. That is true of IBDP online tutors in India as much as of anyone you could meet in person.

Three questions that work. Ask an Economics HL candidate what makes Paper 3 different from Paper 2 in practice, and listen for policy calculation and recommendation rather than a vague answer about data. Ask a Physics HL candidate which Additional Higher Level topics students find hardest and how they teach one of them. Ask an English A HL candidate how they prepare a student for two unseen passages instead of one, and what their approach is to the HL essay at 1,200 to 1,500 words.

A general answer to any of those is your answer. "I have taught IB for many years" is not a claim about Higher Level. Neither is a subject degree, which tells you what the tutor knows and nothing about whether they can move a seventeen-year-old through a Paper 2 extended response under timed conditions.

Then do the unglamorous checks. Confirm identity and qualifications yourself rather than taking a profile on trust, ask which year groups and levels they are currently teaching, and for an online arrangement ask to see the setup they will really be using. Keep the first commitment short. A month of sessions reviewed honestly is better evidence than any profile, and you can ask for a different match if the fit is wrong.
items: Ask what makes Economics Paper 3 different from Paper 2 in practice
Ask which Additional Higher Level physics topics students find hardest, and why
Ask how they coach two unseen passages rather than one
Confirm identity and qualifications yourself; a profile is only a starting point
Commit short, review honestly, and change the match if it is wrong

contentBlocks.heading: What an HL trial lesson must test, and how to score it
contentBlocks.body:
A trial for a Standard Level subject can be a pleasant conversation and still tell you enough. A Higher Level trial cannot. Send the tutor the student's own marked work in advance, name the topic you want covered, and then watch what they do with the hardest forty minutes of it.

Set the task at HL depth deliberately. For Mathematics AA HL, give them a proof question the student got wrong, not a routine differentiation. For Physics HL, give them an extended-response question from Paper 2 where the student wrote a number and lost the explanation marks. For Economics HL, give them the weakest commentary in the portfolio and ask how they would teach the key concept it was meant to use. For English A, give them an unseen passage and ask them to model the opening five minutes of a guided analysis out loud.

What separates good IBDP online tutors in India from plausible ones is visible inside the first twenty minutes, and it is not warmth. Does the tutor find the misconception, or simply re-explain the correct method more slowly? Do they make the student write and talk, or do they talk for fifty minutes? Do they name the criterion or the command term that was missed? Can they say, at the end, what the next four sessions would cover and why in that order? A tutor who cannot sequence a month has not understood the problem.

One more thing to watch, and it is specific to the screen. Ask the tutor to work through a derivation or draw a diagram live during the trial. If they type it, or narrate it without writing anything, the real sessions will be weaker than the trial suggests. You want handwriting appearing on a shared screen at a speed a student can follow, with the student writing back and showing their page.
items: Send marked work in advance and name the exact topic to be covered
Set a proof question, not a routine one, for Mathematics AA HL
Watch whether the tutor finds the misconception or merely re-explains it
Ask for the plan for the next four sessions, with reasons
Make them write a derivation live on a shared screen

contentBlocks.heading: When a Standard Level student does not need any of this
contentBlocks.body:
Most families who search for IBDP online tutors in India are right to, and some are not. If your child is taking Mathematics AI SL, Biology SL and Business Management SL and keeping up, local supply is adequate, the school's teaching covers the course, and a national search for a specialist is effort spent on a problem you do not have.

The SL cases that genuinely need outside help are narrower than parents expect: a student who joined the DP from a different board and is missing assumed knowledge, a student who has fallen behind through a long illness, or a student whose real difficulty is study habits rather than subject content. That last one is not a tutoring problem at all, and a tutor who accepts the booking without saying so is not being straight with you.

Even at Higher Level, the honest sequence starts at school. Ask the subject teacher what specifically is going wrong and what the student should do differently this week. Ask the DP coordinator whether the load across three HLs, the core and CAS is realistic for this particular student. Sometimes the answer is to reduce commitments rather than add a Thursday evening session. A student already at capacity does not improve because one more hour has been added to the week.

Set expectations about time as well. No tutor can guarantee a grade, and nobody should imply that six weeks of sessions will move a Physics HL result. What should change first is smaller and checkable: fewer marks lost to unexplained working, a commentary that actually uses its key concept, a proof attempted rather than skipped, a Paper 1B data question read properly before the pen moves. If none of that has shifted after a month of honest sessions, change something.
items: Mathematics AI SL and Biology SL usually have adequate supply locally
A board switch or a long illness is a real reason to start
Study habits are not fixed by adding another subject session
Ask the subject teacher and the DP coordinator before booking anyone
After a month, look for explanation marks and criterion use, not grades

contentBlocks.heading: Setting up online Higher Level work in India: desk, tablet, derivations
contentBlocks.body:
Before the first session, get the physical setup right, because an HL lesson lives or dies on whether written working can be seen. The student needs a desk with room for paper, the device on a stand rather than in a hand, a headset, and a reliable way to get handwritten pages to the tutor. A phone camera and a scanning app is enough for that.

A graphics tablet on the student's side is optional but changes Mathematics AA HL and Physics HL sessions noticeably. Where one is not available, the workable substitute is a second camera angle on the page, or the student photographing each completed step and sharing it as they go. Agree in the first session which of these you are using, and test it before the tutor is on the clock rather than losing twenty minutes to it.

Bring three things to the first lesson: the school's deadline sheet, the last marked assessment in the subject, and a written note of what the student thinks the problem is. That last one is often the most useful document in the room. A student who writes "I follow it in class and then cannot start the question at home" has told the tutor exactly where to begin, and saved a session of diagnosis.

Agree the rhythm too. For a scarce Higher Level subject, one longer session a week usually beats two short ones, because derivations and extended responses need room to finish. Decide what happens when a session is missed, how often you will hear from the tutor, and when you will review. Then leave it alone for a month. Changing tutors after two sessions tells you nothing except that the first two sessions felt awkward, which they very often do.
items: A desk, a stand for the device, a headset, and paper within reach
A scanning app so handwritten working reaches the tutor the same evening
Bring the deadline sheet and the last marked assessment to session one
One longer weekly session beats two short ones for HL derivations
Agree the missed-session rule and the review date before you start

faqs.question: My son takes Mathematics AA HL and nobody in our city teaches it. What now?
faqs.answer: Widen the search to online and treat distance as irrelevant. Mathematics AA HL is the hardest DP course to staff locally, because AA is algebraic and proof-heavy while most available tutors have taught Applications and Interpretation or a school board syllabus instead. A family in Coimbatore or Raipur will usually find nobody within reach who has taught AA HL through to an exam session. IBDP online tutors in India solve this by pooling supply nationally, so the question stops being who is nearby and becomes who has actually taught the course.

faqs.question: Does online really work for Physics HL, with all the diagrams and derivations?
faqs.answer: Yes, provided the tutor has a proper setup and insists that the student writes. Diagrams and derivations are exactly where a casual online lesson fails, so check at the trial that the tutor draws live on a shared screen rather than describing things aloud. The student needs to be writing too, on paper that is photographed and shared, or on a tablet. Where that discipline holds, Physics HL online is fine. Where the tutor talks for an hour over slides, it is not, and subject knowledge does not rescue it.

faqs.question: How is an online tutor checked when we will never meet them in person?
faqs.answer: Profiles are verified before they go live, and matching asks about board, syllabus, level, school calendar, location and schedule, but you should still run your own checks. Confirm identity and qualifications directly, ask which levels and year groups they are currently teaching, and ask one Higher Level question that cannot be bluffed. A demo or trial session can be arranged before you commit, and you can ask for a different match if the fit turns out wrong. Keep the first commitment short and review it honestly.

faqs.question: What should an HL trial lesson actually cover?
faqs.answer: One hard piece of the student's own marked work, not a general introduction to the subject. Send it in advance and name the topic. For Economics HL, use the weakest commentary in the portfolio or a policy question in the style of Paper 3. For English A at Higher Level, use an unseen passage. What you are watching for is whether the tutor finds the misconception, makes the student write and speak, names the criterion or command term that was missed, and can sequence the next four sessions with a reason for each.

faqs.question: Is home tuition still worth having if the HL tutor is online?
faqs.answer: Often yes, as a hybrid arrangement rather than a replacement. A local home tutor can hold the Standard Level subjects, supervise timed practice and keep study habits honest, while the online specialist takes the Higher Level subject once a week. Families in Pune, Ahmedabad and Salt Lake commonly run exactly this split. Home classes also help a student who drifts quietly online, because presence in the room removes the option. The trade-off is cost and a fuller week, so do not run both across three subjects at once.

faqs.question: Should we start in DP1, or wait and see how DP2 begins?
faqs.answer: For a scarce Higher Level subject, starting in DP1 is usually better and cheaper in effort. DP1 is when the HL foundation is built, and a gap left there becomes a much larger problem once mocks and coursework deadlines stack up through DP2. For a Standard Level subject, waiting is often the right call. The test is not the year but the evidence. If marked work shows a content gap rather than a rough term, start now. If it shows a timing or a habits problem, fix that first.

faqs.question: How many Higher Level subjects can we sensibly tutor at the same time?
faqs.answer: One in most cases, and two only if the student's week genuinely has room for it. Three Higher Levels already carry 240 recommended teaching hours each, on top of Theory of Knowledge, the Extended Essay and CAS. Adding three weekly tuition sessions to that produces a student who attends everything and absorbs very little. Pick the subject where a point is most gettable, get it stable across a term, then reconsider. A tutor who encourages you to book all three at once is selling rather than advising.

faqs.question: Our internet is unreliable. Does that rule online tuition out entirely?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily, but it changes what you should plan for. A dropped connection during a long Physics HL derivation costs more teaching time than one during vocabulary practice, so agree a fallback in advance: a phone hotspot, a short agreed recap at the start of the next session, and written notes from the tutor covering what was done. Families in Guwahati, Ranchi and Bhubaneswar often run sessions on a wired connection where they can. If outages are frequent, a hybrid week with a local home tutor is safer.

faqs.question: The school says my daughter is fine. Do we need a tutor at all?
faqs.answer: Possibly not, and that deserves taking seriously before you book anything. Start by asking the subject teacher what specifically would move the grade, and the DP coordinator whether the overall load is realistic. If the student sits at Standard Level across the board and is keeping up, a national search for a specialist is solving a problem you do not have. The cases that justify starting are a real content gap, a board switch into the DP, or a long absence. A single rough term is not one of them.

faqs.question: What can an online tutor do with an internal assessment without crossing the line?
faqs.answer: They can teach the skill, read the criteria with the student and ask hard questions about a draft. They cannot write, rewrite or edit any part of it. For a scientific investigation, a tutor can discuss what Research design or Evaluation is asking for and whether the student's method answers it. For an Economics commentary of up to 800 words, they can question whether the chosen key concept is genuinely used. The words that reach the school must be the student's own, and the supervisor settles any doubt.

faqs.question: How quickly can an IBDP HL online tutor start, and what if the fit is wrong?
faqs.answer: It depends on the subject and the slot, and availability is always subject to the tutor's existing timetable. A Standard Level request usually matches faster than an Economics HL or Mathematics AA HL request, simply because fewer people teach the second kind. Once a shortlist arrives, a demo or trial session can be arranged before you commit. If the fit is wrong after a few sessions, ask for a different match rather than persisting out of politeness, and say what was wrong specifically.

mainEntity.name: My son takes Mathematics AA HL and nobody in our city teaches it. What now?

acceptedAnswer.text: Widen the search to online and treat distance as irrelevant. Mathematics AA HL is the hardest DP course to staff locally, because AA is algebraic and proof-heavy while most available tutors have taught Applications and Interpretation or a school board syllabus instead. A family in Coimbatore or Raipur will usually find nobody within reach who has taught AA HL through to an exam session. IBDP online tutors in India solve this by pooling supply nationally, so the question stops being who is nearby and becomes who has actually taught the course.

mainEntity.name: Does online really work for Physics HL, with all the diagrams and derivations?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, provided the tutor has a proper setup and insists that the student writes. Diagrams and derivations are exactly where a casual online lesson fails, so check at the trial that the tutor draws live on a shared screen rather than describing things aloud. The student needs to be writing too, on paper that is photographed and shared, or on a tablet. Where that discipline holds, Physics HL online is fine. Where the tutor talks for an hour over slides, it is not, and subject knowledge does not rescue it.

mainEntity.name: How is an online tutor checked when we will never meet them in person?

acceptedAnswer.text: Profiles are verified before they go live, and matching asks about board, syllabus, level, school calendar, location and schedule, but you should still run your own checks. Confirm identity and qualifications directly, ask which levels and year groups they are currently teaching, and ask one Higher Level question that cannot be bluffed. A demo or trial session can be arranged before you commit, and you can ask for a different match if the fit turns out wrong. Keep the first commitment short and review it honestly.

mainEntity.name: What should an HL trial lesson actually cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: One hard piece of the student's own marked work, not a general introduction to the subject. Send it in advance and name the topic. For Economics HL, use the weakest commentary in the portfolio or a policy question in the style of Paper 3. For English A at Higher Level, use an unseen passage. What you are watching for is whether the tutor finds the misconception, makes the student write and speak, names the criterion or command term that was missed, and can sequence the next four sessions with a reason for each.

mainEntity.name: Is home tuition still worth having if the HL tutor is online?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often yes, as a hybrid arrangement rather than a replacement. A local home tutor can hold the Standard Level subjects, supervise timed practice and keep study habits honest, while the online specialist takes the Higher Level subject once a week. Families in Pune, Ahmedabad and Salt Lake commonly run exactly this split. Home classes also help a student who drifts quietly online, because presence in the room removes the option. The trade-off is cost and a fuller week, so do not run both across three subjects at once.

mainEntity.name: Should we start in DP1, or wait and see how DP2 begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a scarce Higher Level subject, starting in DP1 is usually better and cheaper in effort. DP1 is when the HL foundation is built, and a gap left there becomes a much larger problem once mocks and coursework deadlines stack up through DP2. For a Standard Level subject, waiting is often the right call. The test is not the year but the evidence. If marked work shows a content gap rather than a rough term, start now. If it shows a timing or a habits problem, fix that first.

comparison.heading: How do IBDP online tutors in India compare with a batch or a recorded course?
comparison.intro: The choice is rarely about which format is better in general. It is about whether the person teaching your child has actually taught the Higher Level course. A home tutor wins on attention, an online specialist wins on subject depth and reach, a batch wins on cost per hour and peer discussion, and a recorded course wins on being available at eleven at night. Decide which of those your student is short of.
