h1: IB Extended Essay Help in India Within the Rules That Bind It
heroTitle: Extended Essay help in India, without crossing the line
heroSubtitle: The Extended Essay is an independent research essay of up to 4,000 words and roughly 40 hours of work, supervised by a teacher at your child's own school. A home tutor can teach the research skill behind it. Nobody outside the school may write, rewrite or edit the submission, and this page explains exactly where that line falls.
introSummary: IB Extended Essay help in India usually means one specific arrangement: a home tutor who teaches the research and writing skill, while the school supervisor keeps charge of the essay itself. That split is the whole subject of this page. The Extended Essay (EE) is an independent research essay of up to 4,000 words and roughly 40 hours of work, supervised by a teacher at the student's own school, with reflection sessions recorded along the way. It is written in one Diploma Programme (DP) subject or as an interdisciplinary essay, graded A to E, and combined with Theory of Knowledge (TOK) for up to three diploma points. A tutor may teach a student how to narrow a research question until it can actually be answered. A tutor may not write a sentence of the essay. Both halves matter, and families get into trouble by learning only the first.

contentBlocks.heading: How does a request for IB Extended Essay help in India turn into a shortlist?
contentBlocks.body:
It starts with five questions, and none of them is about tutors. Which DP subject is the essay registered in? Has a research question been agreed with the supervisor, or is it still a topic? Which reflection session has already happened? What did the supervisor actually write on the last piece of work handed in? And what is the school's own internal deadline, which is almost always earlier than the one families assume? Those five answers decide everything. A DP2 student three weeks from a full-draft deadline needs a different person from a DP1 student still deciding between a Group 3 essay and a Group 4 one.

Only after that does matching begin. IB Gram asks about board, syllabus, level, school calendar, location and schedule, then shortlists tutors whose profiles are verified and match those needs. For IB Extended Essay help in India the match is narrower than for ordinary subject tuition. A Physics tutor who is strong on Paper 2 is not automatically right for an essay investigating the damping of a driven oscillator, because the essay rewards a controlled method and a sustained argument rather than a fast correct answer. A History tutor who knows the syllabus period may still have never supervised a student through source criticism on a local archive.

The shortlist stays short on purpose. Each profile comes with a plain note on why that person fits this essay, in this subject, at this stage of the year. You then run a demo or trial session before committing, and the sensible way to use it is to bring the student's current research question and watch what the tutor does with it. A tutor who immediately offers a better question has told you something worrying. A tutor who asks what evidence the student could realistically gather before May has told you something useful.

Lessons run at home, online or hybrid, subject to tutor availability. If the fit is wrong after two or three sessions, ask for a different match rather than waiting, because Extended Essay time is the one thing a DP student cannot buy back.
items: 1. Send the DP subject, the draft research question and the school's internal deadline dates.
2. Book a free consultation covering level, supervisor feedback, weekly schedule and locality.
3. Receive verified tutor profiles matched to that subject, that stage and that calendar.
4. Run a demo or trial session using the student's own research question, subject to availability.
5. Fix a weekly slot at home, online or hybrid, and change the match if it is not working.

contentBlocks.heading: Where the Extended Essay sits in the Diploma Programme, and why it earns points in India
contentBlocks.body:
The Diploma Programme runs over two years, DP1 and DP2, with six subjects drawn from six groups. Three or four of those are taken at Higher Level (HL), which carries 240 recommended teaching hours, and the rest at Standard Level (SL) at 150 hours. Every subject is graded 1 to 7. Theory of Knowledge and the Extended Essay together add up to three further points, so the maximum award is 45. The diploma minimum is 24 points, subject to the International Baccalaureate's failing conditions, and Creativity, Activity, Service (CAS) must also be completed.

Read that arithmetic once and the EE stops looking like an optional extra. The essay is graded A to E, and an E in either the EE or TOK is itself a failing condition. A student can sit six strong papers and still not hold a diploma. That is the reason families in India who have never heard of the EE in DP1 suddenly hear about nothing else in DP2, and why an unstarted essay in January is a genuine emergency rather than an administrative one.

Exam sessions run in May and November. Schools in India overwhelmingly enter candidates for the May session, which fits an academic year running roughly April to March, and May results are released in early July. Every EE deadline a family will meet is therefore an internal school deadline set backwards from that May session, not a date published by the IB for parents to look up.

One warning about sources, and it matters more here than anywhere else on this page. The EE guide was updated for first assessment in 2027. Older blog posts, coaching handouts and even some tutors still quote criterion mark allocations from the previous version. Do not use them. The only version that counts is the one your DP coordinator issues to the cohort, and a tutor who cannot tell you which version they are working from should not be marking anything against criteria.
items: Six subjects from six groups; three or four at HL, 240 hours, the rest SL at 150.
Subjects graded 1 to 7; TOK and the EE add up to three points towards a maximum of 45.
An E grade in the Extended Essay is a failing condition, whatever the six subject grades say.
Indian schools enter the May session; results arrive in early July.
Follow only the EE guide version your DP coordinator issues, updated for first assessment in 2027.

contentBlocks.heading: Can a research question actually be answered in 4,000 words?
contentBlocks.body:
Most of them cannot, and that is the single most common reason an essay goes wrong. Up to 4,000 words sounds enormous to a sixteen-year-old and is in fact very little once background, method, evidence, analysis and evaluation each take their share. A question like 'To what extent did liberalisation change the Indian economy' is a book. A question naming one industry, one measurable outcome and two fixed years is an essay, because the evidence has edges and the student can see the finish line from the start.

The test is simple to apply at home. Ask the student to say, in one breath, what evidence they will gather, where it will come from, and what answer would count as 'no'. If they cannot, the question is still a topic. A Group 4 essay asking how the temperature of a tennis ball affects its coefficient of restitution passes that test: the student knows what to measure, what to vary and what to control. An essay asking how temperature affects materials does not, and it will still be vague in February.

The essay is written in one DP subject or as an interdisciplinary essay, and the subject choice does more work than students expect. The same curiosity about a local lake becomes a Biology essay about a named indicator species, a Geography essay about catchment land use, or an Economics essay about a pricing externality, and each of those is assessed by that subject's own criteria. Choosing the subject the student is stronger in usually beats choosing the subject the topic first suggested.

This is also where a tutor earns their fee legitimately. Good IB extended essay guidance at this stage is almost entirely questioning: what would you measure, who has already written about this, what will you do if the data is thin in February. The student writes the question down. The supervisor approves it. The tutor never hands one over, because an extended essay research question that arrived from outside tends to collapse the moment the student has to defend it in a reflection session.
items: Name the outcome, the variable and the boundary: one industry, one species, two fixed years.
Ask what evidence exists before falling in love with the topic.
Pick the subject the student is stronger in, not the one the topic first suggests.
An interdisciplinary essay is allowed, and is harder to keep inside 4,000 words.
The student writes the question, the supervisor approves it, the tutor only questions it.

contentBlocks.heading: IB Extended Essay help in India: home tuition from Delhi NCR to Kochi
contentBlocks.body:
In Delhi NCR the essay competes with the road. A student in Vasant Kunj, Chanakyapuri or South Delhi can usually hold a weekday evening slot without much trouble. A family in Sector 128 Noida, Greater Noida, Faridabad or Ghaziabad is asking a tutor to cross the region at the worst hour, and evening traffic between Gurugram (Gurgaon) and South Delhi can stretch a short trip badly. Families looking for IB Extended Essay help in Delhi often settle on one longer home visit at the weekend, with a short midweek call to check reading. Along Golf Course Road and in Dwarka the same pattern wins.

The Mumbai Metropolitan Region splits differently. Bandra, Juhu, Andheri, Worli, Lower Parel, Malabar Hill and Powai sit close enough together that a home tutor can hold two evenings a week, while Navi Mumbai, Vashi, Kharghar and Thane are a separate travel problem in the monsoon. Parents searching for IB Extended Essay help in Mumbai from those suburbs frequently take a hybrid week rather than lose a session to waterlogging in July, which is exactly when a DP1 student should be settling a research question.

Bengaluru is the clearest case for hybrid home tuition. A specialist living in Jayanagar or on Kanakapura Road will not reliably reach Whitefield or Sarjapur Road on a weekday evening, and families in Electronic City, Hebbal or Yelahanka face the same arithmetic in reverse; HSR Layout, Koramangala and Indiranagar have the shortest hops. IB Extended Essay help in Bangalore therefore often runs as one home session and one online session. Chennai behaves better: Adyar, Besant Nagar, Alwarpet and Nungambakkam are compact, while Anna Nagar, Velachery, Perungudi and Old Mahabalipuram Road (OMR) stretch a tutor's evening. Requests for IB Extended Essay help in Chennai, in Hyderabad and in Pune follow one rule: proximity buys reliability, not quality.

Outside those clusters the arithmetic changes. Across southern India beyond Bengaluru and Chennai, in Kochi, Thiruvananthapuram, Coimbatore, Mysuru, Mangaluru, Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada and Madurai, the specialist a particular essay needs may simply not live in the city, and the same holds for the rarer subjects in Kolkata and Ahmedabad. Finding an Extended Essay tutor anywhere in India is a supply problem before it is a preference, and online is often the honest answer rather than the fallback.
items: Delhi NCR: weekend home visits usually beat weekday evenings across Noida, Faridabad and Ghaziabad.
Mumbai Metropolitan Region: Navi Mumbai, Vashi, Kharghar and Thane suit a hybrid week in monsoon months.
Bengaluru: Whitefield, Sarjapur Road and Electronic City rarely sustain a cross-city weekday home tutor.
Chennai: Adyar, Besant Nagar and Alwarpet are compact; OMR, Perungudi and Velachery are not.
Southern India beyond the metros: Kochi, Coimbatore, Mysuru and Visakhapatnam usually need an online specialist.

contentBlocks.heading: Which school deadlines in India really govern the Extended Essay?
contentBlocks.body:
The ones your coordinator sets, and they are earlier than you think. Parents arrive naming a school, Dhirubhai Ambani International School, Oberoi International School, Ecole Mondiale World School, Pathways World School, Stonehill International School, Indus International School, Oakridge International School, Mahindra International School, Good Shepherd International School or The International School Bangalore, as though the name settles the timetable. It does not. Internal EE deadlines differ between schools and between cohorts in the same school, and the only reliable source is the sheet the DP coordinator hands out. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school named here, the International Baccalaureate, Cambridge International Education or Pearson Edexcel.

What is common across international schools in India is the shape of the year. The academic year runs roughly April to March and candidates are entered for the May session, so DP1 usually carries subject choice, topic selection and the first reflection session, and the summer break between DP1 and DP2 is where the research is supposed to happen. It frequently does not. A student who arrives in DP2 with a question but no data has lost the cheapest months of the whole project.

Then DP2 stacks up. Internal assessment deadlines in several subjects, mock examinations, CAS obligations still open, and university applications for students applying abroad all land in the same two terms as the EE full draft and the final reflection session. Schools stagger these deadlines deliberately, which is why a home tutor who has read the school's published calendar plans a term differently from one who only knows the subject.

Practical advice for parents: photograph the coordinator's deadline sheet and share it with the home tutor in the first session. Ask the school which date is the draft the supervisor will comment on, because the IB's academic integrity policy allows a teacher to give feedback on one draft, and a student who spends that single comment on an unfinished chapter has thrown away the most valuable feedback in the entire process.
items: Internal EE deadlines come from the DP coordinator's sheet, not from any public IB calendar.
The DP1 summer break is the natural research window, and the one most often wasted.
DP2 stacks internal assessments, mocks, CAS and applications against the EE draft deadline.
Identify which draft the supervisor will comment on before submitting anything to them.
Share the school calendar with the home tutor in the first session, not the fourth.

contentBlocks.heading: Home tuition, online or hybrid for Extended Essay sessions in India?
contentBlocks.body:
Home tuition wins on accountability, online wins on supply, and hybrid wins for most DP2 students in a metro. That is the comparison in one sentence, and everything below is detail about which constraint is biting hardest in your house.

A home tutor sitting beside the student sees what a screen hides. Whether the reading has been done or only downloaded. Whether the notes exist. Whether the student opens the document and immediately reformats the title page instead of writing. For the Extended Essay, where the failure mode is avoidance rather than misunderstanding, that visibility is worth a great deal, and a fixed weekly home session creates an external deadline in a project that otherwise has almost none between reflection sessions. Home classes also make the parent's role easier to keep correct: present in the house, not in the room.

Online wins on a different axis. A student writing in a thinly taught subject, or attempting an interdisciplinary essay, may need someone who does not live in their city at all. Screen sharing suits this work unusually well, because most of a session is two people looking at the same document, the same criterion descriptor from the coordinator's guide, or the same source. Online sessions also survive monsoon evenings and exam-week timetable changes that would cancel a visit outright.

Hybrid is what most families actually run once DP2 starts. One home visit for the long drafting and planning work, one shorter online call midweek to hold the student to the plan. It handles the travel problem and the motivation problem together, and it is the usual shape of IB Extended Essay help in India once the calendar tightens. The honest limit of all three modes is identical: none of them lets anyone else write the essay, so none of them rescues a student who will not start.
items: Home tuition: highest accountability, and it creates a weekly deadline the essay otherwise lacks.
Online: reaches the subject specialist your city may not have, and survives monsoon and mock weeks.
Hybrid: one home visit for drafting, one online call midweek to keep the plan honest.
Screen sharing suits this work because most of a session is two people reading one document.
No mode changes the boundary; the student writes every word in all three.

contentBlocks.heading: How do you check an Extended Essay tutor will respect the boundary?
contentBlocks.body:
Ask them, in the trial session, to describe something they have refused to do. A tutor who has worked on Extended Essays honestly will have a ready answer, because the request comes constantly and refusing it is part of the job. A tutor who looks puzzled by the question has either never done this work or has been doing it the wrong way.

IB Gram verifies profiles before they go live: identity, the qualifications a tutor claims, and the subjects and levels they say they teach. What a platform cannot see is what happens in the twelfth session at eleven at night when a draft is due the next morning, so the family's own checks matter as much as ours. Watch for the tutor who offers to polish the draft, who sends a sample essay in the same subject so the student can see the structure, who asks for the document with editing rights rather than comment rights, or who tells you the school will never know. Each of those is a warning sign, and the last one is simply false.

It is false because of how submission works. The school submits the work and runs it through similarity checking, and malpractice findings are handled by the IB, not by the school alone. A supervisor who has watched a student reason aloud through several reflection sessions also knows what that student's writing sounds like. The risk is not abstract, the consequence falls on the candidate rather than on the tutor, and no refund repairs it.

The questions worth asking before you book are narrow. Which version of the EE guide are you working from? How do you give feedback on a paragraph without rewriting it? What will you do if my child asks you to fix the conclusion the night before the deadline? You are not testing subject knowledge with any of these. You are testing whether the person understands that the EE help IB families can legitimately buy is coaching in a skill, not production of a document.
items: Ask the tutor to describe a request they have refused, and listen for a ready answer.
Give comment rights on the document, never editing rights.
A sample essay in the same subject, offered for structure, is a warning sign rather than a resource.
Confirm which version of the EE guide the tutor is working from.
The school runs similarity checking, and the IB rather than the school alone rules on malpractice.

contentBlocks.heading: The supervisor owns the essay: what an outside tutor may and may not do
contentBlocks.body:
The Extended Essay is supervised by a teacher at the student's own school, with reflection sessions recorded along the way. That supervisor is not a formality and cannot be replaced by anyone you hire. They approve the research question, they hold the reflection conversations, they write the supervisor comment, and they are the one person entitled to give feedback on a draft. The IB's academic integrity policy allows a teacher to give feedback on one draft. It does not allow anyone, tutor or parent, to write, rewrite or edit the student's submission.

Take a real situation. A DP2 student in Powai has written an analysis paragraph that states a finding but never connects it back to the research question. Here is what a tutor may legitimately do. Read the paragraph with the student and ask what the reader is supposed to conclude from it. Point at the relevant criterion in the coordinator's copy of the guide and ask the student to reread their own paragraph against it. Teach, on a completely different example, how a claim is linked to evidence and then back to the question. Then close the laptop and let the student rewrite the paragraph alone.

Here is what would be malpractice. Typing a better version of the sentence into the document. Dictating a topic sentence for the student to copy down. Rewriting the conclusion to show what good looks like and leaving it there. Restructuring the whole essay in a comment for the student to paste in. Correcting every reference so the student never learns the style. Producing a marked-up draft that functions as a second supervisor comment when the policy allows one. None of those becomes acceptable because the student typed the final keystrokes.

The distinction holding all of this together is between the skill and the artefact. A tutor may teach the skill without limit: search strategy, source evaluation, experimental design, how to structure an argument, how to read a criterion descriptor. The artefact, the 4,000 words that get submitted, belongs entirely to the student. Families buying IB Extended Essay help in India should say this out loud to the tutor in the first session, because the pressure to cross the line rarely comes from a dishonest tutor. It comes from a frightened student at midnight.
items: May: question the reasoning, point at a criterion, ask the student to reread their own paragraph.
May: teach referencing, search strategy and experimental design on examples outside the essay.
May not: write, rewrite or edit any sentence that will be submitted.
May not: supply a research question, a structure to paste in, or a model paragraph left in place.
The supervisor gives feedback on one draft; a tutor's marked-up draft must never substitute for it.
Reflection sessions are between student and supervisor, and a tutor has no place in them.

contentBlocks.heading: The 40 hours: where they really go, and what honest progress looks like
contentBlocks.body:
Roughly 40 hours is the figure, and families misread it as writing time. It is not. A realistic split puts a large early block into reading and narrowing, because finding out that the intended question has already been answered, or cannot be answered with the sources available, takes several sittings and is work well spent. Then comes gathering: the experiment run and rerun, the archive read, the survey designed, the dataset cleaned. Only after that does drafting begin, and drafting is rarely the largest share of the total.

Reflection sessions and the supervisor's comments sit across the whole span, and the hours spent preparing for one are real hours. A student who walks into a reflection session with nothing to report has wasted a checkpoint that exists precisely to catch a stalling project. Preparing properly means being able to say what has changed since last time, what went wrong, and what the next concrete step is.

So what does progress look like from a parent's chair? In DP1, a subject chosen and a question that has survived being narrowed twice. Over the summer, sources actually read and notes that exist as notes rather than as open browser tabs. Early in DP2, data in hand and an outline that maps evidence to argument. Then a full draft that goes to the supervisor as the one draft they may comment on, and a final version the student revises alone. If a month of IB Extended Essay help in India has produced no movement along that sequence, the tutoring is not working, whatever the sessions felt like at the time.

The honest limits deserve stating plainly. No tutor can guarantee a grade on an essay they are forbidden to write. Starting in the last term narrows the work to salvaging a structure and finishing something submittable. A weak research question cannot be rescued late without abandoning research already done, which is a decision only the student and the supervisor can take. And some students do not need a tutor at all. They need the supervisor's time and a calendar they actually keep.
items: Reading and narrowing usually consume more of the 40 hours than drafting does.
Preparing for a reflection session is real project time, not overhead.
DP1 milestone: a question that has survived being narrowed at least twice.
Summer milestone: sources read and notes written, not browser tabs left open.
No movement along that sequence after a month means the tutoring is not working.

contentBlocks.heading: Starting Extended Essay home tuition in India: what to send before the first session
contentBlocks.body:
Four things, and they take ten minutes to gather. The DP subject the essay is registered in. The current research question, in whatever rough state it exists. The coordinator's deadline sheet, photographed. And the supervisor's last written comment, which is usually the single most informative document a tutor can read before meeting the student.

Send those with a note about your locality and the evenings that actually work, because a weekday slot in Andheri and a weekday slot in Greater Noida are not the same request. Say whether you want home classes, online sessions or a hybrid week. Say whether there is a quiet room, or whether the dining table is the study space, which is perfectly normal and worth the home tutor knowing in advance rather than discovering.

The first session then has a fixed job. The tutor reads the question aloud with the student and tests whether it can be answered with evidence the student can actually obtain before the school deadline. They map the remaining weeks against the coordinator's dates. They establish what the student already has: sources, data, notes, or nothing. And they agree out loud what the tutor will and will not touch, which should be said in front of the parent so that nobody is confused about it later in the year.

What you get afterwards is a weekly rhythm and a plan the student can hold, not a manuscript. A demo or trial session can be arranged before you commit, availability depends on the subject and the schedule you need, and if the match is wrong you can ask for a different tutor. That is the whole of what IB Extended Essay help in India should be, and anyone offering more than that on an Extended Essay is offering something you should refuse.
items: Send the DP subject, the current research question and the coordinator's deadline sheet.
Include the supervisor's most recent written comment on the student's work.
Say which evenings work and whether you want home classes, online or a hybrid week.
The first session tests the question against evidence the student can actually obtain.
Agree the boundary aloud in the first session, with the parent present.

faqs.question: Can a tutor write or edit any part of my child's Extended Essay?
faqs.answer: No, and this is the one rule with no exceptions. The IB's academic integrity policy allows a teacher to give feedback on one draft; it does not allow anyone, tutor or parent, to write, rewrite or edit the student's submission. A tutor may teach the underlying skill, question the reasoning, point at a criterion and ask the student to reread their own paragraph against it. The school submits the work and runs it through similarity checking, and malpractice findings are handled by the IB rather than by the school alone. The consequence falls on the candidate.

faqs.question: What can an Extended Essay tutor legitimately do, then?
faqs.answer: Plenty, and it is the part that actually raises the quality of the essay. A tutor can teach search strategy and source evaluation, help the student test whether a research question is answerable with evidence they can obtain, teach experimental design or data handling on examples outside the essay, explain how a criterion descriptor is worded, and ask the questions that expose a gap in the reasoning. They can also hold the student to a weekly plan. What they hand back is a better researcher, not a better document.

faqs.question: How do we narrow a research question so it fits 4,000 words?
faqs.answer: Add boundaries until the evidence has edges. Name one case, one variable, one period, one text or one population. A useful test at home: ask the student to state in one breath what they will measure or read, where it comes from, and what result would count as a negative answer. If they cannot, it is still a topic rather than a question. The supervisor approves the final wording, and a question the student cannot defend in a reflection session was never really theirs.

faqs.question: Is a home tutor better than online help for Extended Essay work?
faqs.answer: For accountability usually yes, for subject match often no. A home tutor sees whether the reading was actually done and creates a weekly deadline in a project that otherwise has almost none between reflection sessions. An online specialist may be the only person who understands an unusual method or a thinly taught subject. Most DP2 families in metros end up hybrid: one home visit for drafting, one shorter online call midweek. Decide on which constraint is hurting more, rather than on preference.

faqs.question: Our home tutor in Mumbai already teaches my child Economics. Can they supervise the Extended Essay?
faqs.answer: No. The Extended Essay is supervised by a teacher at the student's own school, and that role cannot be transferred to anyone the family hires, however well they know the student. Your home tutor in Bandra or Powai can support the research skill and help the student prepare for reflection sessions, but the supervisor approves the research question, holds the recorded reflection sessions and writes the supervisor comment. Treat the two as separate jobs, and tell the tutor at the start which one they hold.

faqs.question: Where do the 40 hours actually go?
faqs.answer: Mostly not into writing. Roughly 40 hours is the expected scale of the whole project, and reading and narrowing typically take a large early block, because discovering that a question cannot be answered with the available sources is itself necessary work. Gathering comes next: running an experiment, reading an archive, cleaning a dataset. Drafting is rarely the biggest share, and preparing for reflection sessions counts too. Students who treat the figure as writing time start far too late.

faqs.question: What happens in a reflection session, and can our tutor join one?
faqs.answer: It is a recorded conversation between the student and the school supervisor about how the research is going, and no outside tutor attends. The student should arrive able to say what has changed since last time, what went wrong, and what the next concrete step will be. A tutor can help the student prepare for it, which is legitimate and often valuable, but the session itself belongs to the supervisor. Ask your coordinator how many are scheduled and when, because schools time them differently.

faqs.question: We live in Hyderabad and the right specialist is in Bengaluru. What do we do?
faqs.answer: Take the specialist online, and add a local tutor only if the problem is discipline rather than subject depth. For an essay in a thinly taught subject, the person who understands the method matters more than the person who can reach your door, and screen sharing suits this work well because most of a session is two people reading the same document. Families in Kochi, Coimbatore, Visakhapatnam and Mysuru face the same shortage constantly, and online is the honest answer rather than a compromise.

faqs.question: The school draft deadline is a month away and almost nothing is written. What now?
faqs.answer: Talk to the supervisor before hiring anybody. They can tell you what a submittable essay looks like from where your child currently stands, and whether the question needs abandoning. After that, a tutor can help build a week-by-week plan and hold the student to it. Be realistic about what is left: starting this late usually means salvaging a structure and finishing something honest rather than producing the essay the student first imagined. No tutor can guarantee a grade on work they may not write.

faqs.question: Which version of the Extended Essay guide should we follow?
faqs.answer: The version your DP coordinator issues to the cohort, and nothing else. The EE guide was updated for first assessment in 2027, so older handouts, blog posts and coaching notes frequently quote criterion mark allocations that no longer apply. Never let a tutor mark your child's work against numbers pulled off the internet. Ask the coordinator for the current document, share it with the tutor, and treat any tutor who cannot tell you which version they are using as unprepared for the job.

faqs.question: Can a tutor fix the referencing and proofread for grammar?
faqs.answer: Teaching referencing is fine, doing it is not. A tutor may explain the referencing style, work through examples that are not from the essay, and point out that a section has a problem with citation consistency. Correcting the entries themselves means the student never learns the skill and means someone else edited the submission. The same applies to proofreading: naming a recurring error pattern is teaching, while silently repairing sentences inside the document is editing, and only one of those is permitted.

faqs.question: How much do Extended Essay sessions cost, and how often should they run?
faqs.answer: Fees depend on subject, level, locality and whether sessions run at home or online, so any figure quoted before those are known is guesswork. Frequency matters more than intensity here. One steady weekly session across DP1 and early DP2 does more than a block of daily sessions in the final month, because the essay is limited by research done between meetings rather than by contact hours. Availability depends on the subject and the schedule you need.

mainEntity.name: Can a tutor write or edit any part of my child's Extended Essay?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, and this is the one rule with no exceptions. The IB's academic integrity policy allows a teacher to give feedback on one draft; it does not allow anyone, tutor or parent, to write, rewrite or edit the student's submission. A tutor may teach the underlying skill, question the reasoning, point at a criterion and ask the student to reread their own paragraph against it. The school submits the work and runs it through similarity checking, and malpractice findings are handled by the IB rather than by the school alone. The consequence falls on the candidate.

mainEntity.name: What can an Extended Essay tutor legitimately do, then?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plenty, and it is the part that actually raises the quality of the essay. A tutor can teach search strategy and source evaluation, help the student test whether a research question is answerable with evidence they can obtain, teach experimental design or data handling on examples outside the essay, explain how a criterion descriptor is worded, and ask the questions that expose a gap in the reasoning. They can also hold the student to a weekly plan. What they hand back is a better researcher, not a better document.

mainEntity.name: How do we narrow a research question so it fits 4,000 words?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add boundaries until the evidence has edges. Name one case, one variable, one period, one text or one population. A useful test at home: ask the student to state in one breath what they will measure or read, where it comes from, and what result would count as a negative answer. If they cannot, it is still a topic rather than a question. The supervisor approves the final wording, and a question the student cannot defend in a reflection session was never really theirs.

mainEntity.name: Is a home tutor better than online help for Extended Essay work?

acceptedAnswer.text: For accountability usually yes, for subject match often no. A home tutor sees whether the reading was actually done and creates a weekly deadline in a project that otherwise has almost none between reflection sessions. An online specialist may be the only person who understands an unusual method or a thinly taught subject. Most DP2 families in metros end up hybrid: one home visit for drafting, one shorter online call midweek. Decide on which constraint is hurting more, rather than on preference.

mainEntity.name: Our home tutor in Mumbai already teaches my child Economics. Can they supervise the Extended Essay?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The Extended Essay is supervised by a teacher at the student's own school, and that role cannot be transferred to anyone the family hires, however well they know the student. Your home tutor in Bandra or Powai can support the research skill and help the student prepare for reflection sessions, but the supervisor approves the research question, holds the recorded reflection sessions and writes the supervisor comment. Treat the two as separate jobs, and tell the tutor at the start which one they hold.

mainEntity.name: Where do the 40 hours actually go?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mostly not into writing. Roughly 40 hours is the expected scale of the whole project, and reading and narrowing typically take a large early block, because discovering that a question cannot be answered with the available sources is itself necessary work. Gathering comes next: running an experiment, reading an archive, cleaning a dataset. Drafting is rarely the biggest share, and preparing for reflection sessions counts too. Students who treat the figure as writing time start far too late.

mainEntity.name: What happens in a reflection session, and can our tutor join one?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is a recorded conversation between the student and the school supervisor about how the research is going, and no outside tutor attends. The student should arrive able to say what has changed since last time, what went wrong, and what the next concrete step will be. A tutor can help the student prepare for it, which is legitimate and often valuable, but the session itself belongs to the supervisor. Ask your coordinator how many are scheduled and when, because schools time them differently.

mainEntity.name: We live in Hyderabad and the right specialist is in Bengaluru. What do we do?

acceptedAnswer.text: Take the specialist online, and add a local tutor only if the problem is discipline rather than subject depth. For an essay in a thinly taught subject, the person who understands the method matters more than the person who can reach your door, and screen sharing suits this work well because most of a session is two people reading the same document. Families in Kochi, Coimbatore, Visakhapatnam and Mysuru face the same shortage constantly, and online is the honest answer rather than a compromise.

mainEntity.name: The school draft deadline is a month away and almost nothing is written. What now?

acceptedAnswer.text: Talk to the supervisor before hiring anybody. They can tell you what a submittable essay looks like from where your child currently stands, and whether the question needs abandoning. After that, a tutor can help build a week-by-week plan and hold the student to it. Be realistic about what is left: starting this late usually means salvaging a structure and finishing something honest rather than producing the essay the student first imagined. No tutor can guarantee a grade on work they may not write.

mainEntity.name: Which version of the Extended Essay guide should we follow?

acceptedAnswer.text: The version your DP coordinator issues to the cohort, and nothing else. The EE guide was updated for first assessment in 2027, so older handouts, blog posts and coaching notes frequently quote criterion mark allocations that no longer apply. Never let a tutor mark your child's work against numbers pulled off the internet. Ask the coordinator for the current document, share it with the tutor, and treat any tutor who cannot tell you which version they are using as unprepared for the job.

mainEntity.name: Can a tutor fix the referencing and proofread for grammar?

acceptedAnswer.text: Teaching referencing is fine, doing it is not. A tutor may explain the referencing style, work through examples that are not from the essay, and point out that a section has a problem with citation consistency. Correcting the entries themselves means the student never learns the skill and means someone else edited the submission. The same applies to proofreading: naming a recurring error pattern is teaching, while silently repairing sentences inside the document is editing, and only one of those is permitted.

mainEntity.name: How much do Extended Essay sessions cost, and how often should they run?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fees depend on subject, level, locality and whether sessions run at home or online, so any figure quoted before those are known is guesswork. Frequency matters more than intensity here. One steady weekly session across DP1 and early DP2 does more than a block of daily sessions in the final month, because the essay is limited by research done between meetings rather than by contact hours. Availability depends on the subject and the schedule you need.

finalCta: Send the DP subject, the current research question, the coordinator's deadline sheet and the supervisor's last comment, or book a free consultation and we will ask for them. You will get a short list of verified tutor profiles matched to that subject and stage, a demo or trial session before you commit, and lessons at home, online or hybrid. If the fit is wrong, ask for a different match.

heroTitle: Internal Assessment Support Across Subjects in India
heroSubtitle: Three internal assessments, three mark schemes, one exhausted student. This page compares the sciences scientific investigation, the mathematics exploration and the economics portfolio: their criteria, weightings and word limits, and the drafting rule that governs all of them. It also says what a tutor may legitimately do, and what no honest tutor will touch.
introSummary: IB IA help in India usually means one specific emergency: a DP2 student with two or three internal assessments due in the same weeks, and no idea which one to open first. A home tutor sitting beside that student can do a great deal of real work, and there is a hard line on what that work is. The sciences scientific investigation, the mathematics exploration and the economics portfolio are marked on different criteria, carry different word limits and reward different habits. The skill underneath all three is the same: frame a question you can actually answer, then answer it against the criteria you were handed. This page sets the three side by side, explains the one draft rule, and says plainly what a tutor may and may not touch.

contentBlocks.heading: How does a panicked internal assessment request in India become a matched tutor?
contentBlocks.body:
Send three things and the match becomes straightforward: the subject, which internal assessment it is, and the date the school wants the draft. IB Gram then asks about board, syllabus, level, school calendar, location and schedule, and shortlists tutors whose profiles are verified against exactly that. A demo or trial session can be arranged before you commit to anything.

The procedure exists because these enquiries arrive badly described. A parent writes that their daughter needs help with her IA, and that single word could mean a Biology scientific investigation whose data will not support any conclusion, a mathematics exploration that still contains no mathematics, or an economics portfolio in which two commentaries lean on the same key concept. Those are three different problems, and often three different tutors.

So the first conversation is diagnostic rather than persuasive. What does the teacher's written feedback actually say, in the criterion's own words? Which criterion is losing marks, and is it the same one across subjects? Has the one draft the teacher may comment on already been used, or is it still in hand? That last answer reshapes the whole plan, because the commentable draft is a single-use asset, and spending it on half-finished work throws it away.

Use the trial on the real internal assessment, not on a sample topic. Put the criterion descriptor on the table, ask your child to read their own paragraph against it, and watch what the tutor does next. A good one asks a question and then waits. A weaker one starts dictating sentences, and you have learned that in forty minutes rather than in April. If the fit is wrong you can ask for a different match, and during coursework season that matters more than at any other point in the two years, because no family has a spare fortnight to spend being polite.

Location is part of the match, not an afterthought. A tutor who can reach Powai or Koramangala on a weekday evening holds a fortnightly draft review far better than one who cannot, which is why home tuition is still the default request even from families who end up online.
items: 1. Send the subject, the IA type and the school's draft deadline.
2. Share the teacher's written criterion feedback, not your summary of it.
3. Say whether the one commentable draft has already been used.
4. Take a trial session on the real IA, not a sample topic.
5. Agree the weekly slot, the mode, and who reports back to you.

contentBlocks.heading: Where three internal assessments land across DP1 and DP2
contentBlocks.body:
Internal assessment is not a side task bolted onto the Diploma Programme (DP). It is built into the grade of almost every subject, and the arithmetic explains most of the panic. A DP student takes six subjects from six groups, three or four at Higher Level (HL, 240 recommended teaching hours) and the rest at Standard Level (SL, 150 hours). Each subject is graded 1 to 7. Theory of Knowledge (TOK) and the Extended Essay (EE) combine for up to 3 further points, so 45 is the maximum and 24 is the minimum for the diploma, subject to the IB's failing conditions. Creativity, Activity, Service (CAS) must also be completed.

Now count the coursework. A student taking a science, a mathematics course and Economics is carrying three internal assessments, each with its own criteria and its own internal deadline, and those deadlines habitually land in the same months of DP2. Add the Extended Essay and the TOK assessments, and the picture a parent sees in November makes sense: a child who is not actually behind on content, and who is nevertheless underwater.

The weightings are worth stating plainly. The scientific investigation is worth 20% of the science grade. The mathematics exploration is worth 20% of the final grade in that subject, and it is the same task for Analysis and Approaches (AA) and Applications and Interpretation (AI) at both SL and HL. Economics has its own internal assessment in the form of a portfolio. So a student holding two of these is holding a large slice of two final grades in work written at home, at night, around everything else.

HL and SL matter less here than parents expect. In the sciences, HL and SL share the assessment structure; HL simply adds Additional Higher Level (AHL) content on top. In mathematics the exploration is identical in form at both levels, with HL work judged against a higher standard on criterion E. That is useful news for a household budget: an HL student and an SL student can sit in the same session on internal assessment method and both come away with something.
items: Six subjects from six groups, three or four taken at Higher Level
HL 240 recommended teaching hours, SL 150 hours, each subject graded 1 to 7
TOK and the Extended Essay add up to 3 points, so 45 is the maximum
24 points is the diploma minimum, subject to the IB's failing conditions
Two or three internal assessments usually fall in the same DP2 months

contentBlocks.heading: Sciences, maths and economics: three internal assessments compared criterion by criterion
contentBlocks.body:
Three internal assessments, three mark schemes, and the differences are not cosmetic. The sciences scientific investigation is marked on four criteria of 6 marks each, Research design, Data analysis, Conclusion and Evaluation, with a maximum of 3,000 words. The mathematics exploration is marked out of 20 on five criteria and runs to 12-20 pages. The economics portfolio is not one piece of writing at all: it is three separate commentaries, each up to 800 words.

Look at what each mark scheme rewards. In the exploration, the five criteria are A Presentation (4), B Mathematical communication (4), C Personal engagement (3), D Reflection (3) and E Use of mathematics (6). Fourteen of the twenty marks therefore sit outside raw mathematical correctness. A student who produces impeccable algebra and no reflection is throwing away more than a student who produces slightly shakier mathematics inside a well-shaped, genuinely personal piece. HL work is judged against a higher standard on criterion E, which is the one place the level changes anything.

The sciences spread the marks evenly, and that evenness is the trap. Research design and Evaluation together carry half the marks, and they are precisely the two parts students skim: the design gets written after the data was collected, and the evaluation becomes a paragraph about human error. Students may investigate in groups of up to three, but each writes an individual report, so a shared dataset never excuses a shared discussion.

Economics is a planning problem more than a writing problem. Three commentaries, each up to 800 words, each on a published news article, each drawing on a different syllabus unit from Introduction to economics, Microeconomics, Macroeconomics and The global economy, and each using a different one of the nine key concepts: scarcity, choice, efficiency, equity, economic well-being, sustainability, change, interdependence and intervention. The constraint is combinatorial. Choose two easy articles in September without tracking units and concepts, and your child discovers in January that the only combination left requires an article nobody has written.
items: Scientific investigation: 20%, four criteria of 6 marks, maximum 3,000 words
Research design, Data analysis, Conclusion and Evaluation carry equal weight
Mathematics exploration: 20%, 12-20 pages, 20 marks across five criteria
Criterion E Use of mathematics carries 6 of the exploration's 20 marks
Groups of up to three may investigate together, but reports are individual
Economics portfolio: three commentaries of up to 800 words, all differing

contentBlocks.heading: IB IA help in India: where DP2 families are searching, region by region
contentBlocks.body:
IB IA help in India is not evenly spread, and coursework season makes the gaps visible in a way ordinary tuition never does. In Delhi NCR, families in South Delhi, Vasant Kunj and Chanakyapuri have short evening trips and a reasonable local pool. Dwarka, Noida, Sector 128 Noida, Greater Noida, Faridabad and Ghaziabad are a different proposition, and a Gurugram family on Golf Course Road often finds that the specialist they want sits on the far side of a corridor that stops moving after six. Searches for IB IA help in Delhi come from all of these places and mean quite different things.

In the Mumbai Metropolitan Region the phrase families type is IB IA help in Mumbai, but the practical answer is always local. A tutor based in Bandra, Juhu, Andheri or Worli can genuinely hold a weekday slot in Lower Parel or Malabar Hill. Powai is its own pocket, well served but awkward to leave on a weekday evening. Navi Mumbai, Vashi, Thane and Kharghar usually need either a tutor from the same side of the water or a hybrid week, and monsoon months settle that argument on their own.

Bengaluru splits along the same lines. Whitefield, Sarjapur Road and Electronic City families often start out asking for IB IA help in Bangalore and end up running online sessions midweek with a home visit at the weekend, while Indiranagar, Koramangala, HSR Layout, Jayanagar, Hebbal, Yelahanka and Kanakapura Road each have their own evening rhythm. Hyderabad concentrates differently: Gachibowli, HITEC City, Madhapur, Kondapur, Jubilee Hills, Banjara Hills, the Financial District, Kokapet and Secunderabad sit close enough that a request for IB IA help in Hyderabad can often be answered with a person in the room.

Gujarat is where the reach argument earns its keep. In Ahmedabad, families in Satellite, Bodakdev and along SG Highway have some local choice, and Gandhinagar, Surat, Vadodara and Rajkot frequently have none for a specific internal assessment, so IB IA help in Ahmedabad quietly becomes an online arrangement with a specialist elsewhere. The same is true of searches for IB IA help in Chennai, IB IA help in Pune and IB IA help in Kolkata, where supply for one subject can be good and for another nonexistent.

Mumbai: Bandra, Juhu and Worli tutors rarely reach Thane or Kharghar midweek
Bengaluru: Whitefield and Sarjapur Road families often go hybrid during coursework season
Hyderabad: Gachibowli, HITEC City, Kondapur and Jubilee Hills sit close together
Gujarat: Gandhinagar, Surat, Vadodara and Rajkot lean online for DP specialists

contentBlocks.heading: The school calendar in India that fixes every internal assessment deadline
contentBlocks.body:
Exam sessions run in May and November. Schools in India overwhelmingly enter candidates for the May session, which fits an Indian academic year running roughly April to March, and May results are released in early July. Every internal deadline your child meets is derived backwards from that single date, which is why the deadlines feel arbitrary to families and are anything but.

Work the calendar forwards and the pressure points appear on their own. DP1 is when topics should be chosen and, in the sciences, when data should actually be collected, because laboratory access is a school resource and it does not expand in February. The economics portfolio is designed to be gathered across the course rather than assembled in one weekend, since each commentary needs a different unit and a different key concept, and the units are taught in sequence. The mathematics exploration tends to slip furthest, because it has no lab booking and no news cycle forcing it forwards.

Then DP2 arrives and everything stacks. Mock cycles, internal assessment deadlines for two or three subjects, Extended Essay milestones and TOK work often fall within the same few weeks, and each school sets its own internal timetable within the wider requirements. Two students at two different schools in the same city can therefore be working to deadlines a month apart. Ask the DP coordinator for the written internal deadlines at the start of the year and put them on one sheet of paper. Families who do this find the panic is scheduling, not ability.

Names such as Dhirubhai Ambani International School, Oberoi International School, Ecole Mondiale World School, Pathways World School, Stonehill International School, Indus International School, Oakridge International School, Mahindra International School, Good Shepherd International School and The International School Bangalore come up constantly in these conversations, and each runs its own calendar and its own expectations about drafts. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school named here, the International Baccalaureate, Cambridge International Education or Pearson Edexcel. Take the deadline from your own school, in writing, and plan against that rather than against anything you read online.
items: The May session dominates in India; November exists but is unusual here
The Indian academic year runs roughly April to March; May results arrive early July
Data collection belongs in DP1, because laboratory access is a school resource
Mock cycles and internal assessment deadlines often land in the same DP2 weeks
Ask the DP coordinator for every internal deadline in writing, at the start

contentBlocks.heading: Home tuition, online or hybrid for internal assessment work in India?
contentBlocks.body:
For coursework specifically, home tuition wins on diagnosis, online wins on supply, and hybrid is what most DP2 families in India actually end up running. A home tutor sees the real desk: the printed article with nothing underlined, the lab notebook missing two trials, the exploration file that has been open at page three since September. A screen hides all of that, and a student who is avoiding the work is very good at hiding it.

Online earns its place on a different argument. IB IA help in India is thinnest in exactly the subjects where it is most needed, and a family in Rajkot or Gandhinagar may have nobody within reach who has ever supported an economics portfolio. An online specialist who has read many explorations is worth more than a nearby generalist who has read none. Screen sharing also suits criterion work unusually well, because the descriptor and the student's own paragraph can sit side by side and be read line by line, which is exactly the habit you want your child to build.

Hybrid is the honest recommendation for the final stretch. One home session a fortnight for the slow, messy work of fixing a research question or salvaging a dataset, and shorter online checks in between to keep the writing moving. It also survives the two things that reliably break home visits in Indian cities: a monsoon week and an evening when the traffic simply stops.

The trade-off, stated plainly: home tuition buys presence, the whole desk and a parent who can see what is happening; online buys subject depth that may not exist within an hour of your house; hybrid buys most of both and costs you a more complicated calendar. If the problem is that your child cannot start, choose home classes. If the problem is that nobody has explained what criterion E is really asking for, choose the specialist, wherever they happen to live. And if the deadline is close, choose whichever mode gets a session into this week rather than next.
items: Home tuition: the tutor sees the actual desk, files and half-finished draft
Online: reaches a subject specialist your city may not have at all
Hybrid: one home session a fortnight, shorter online checks between
Screen sharing suits criterion reading; paper suits raw data and rough mathematics
Late online slots survive traffic and monsoon; home visits often do not

contentBlocks.heading: What should you check before a home tutor works on an internal assessment?
contentBlocks.body:
Check three things before a home tutor goes anywhere near coursework. That the tutor's identity, qualifications and subject claims have been verified. That they can name your child's criteria without looking them up. And that they will tell you, unprompted, what they refuse to do with a draft. The third is the real test, and it takes one question to run.

IB Gram shortlists tutors whose profiles are verified and who match the board, syllabus, level, calendar, location and schedule you described. That is the platform's half of the work. Your half is subject-specific and nobody can do it for you. Ask which internal assessment the tutor has actually supported and how recently, because a Physics tutor who has never read an exploration should not be coaching your daughter through criterion D. Ask them to describe how they would spend the first session on your child's particular piece. Vague answers about building confidence are an answer.

Then ask the refusal question directly: what will you not do with my child's draft? A tutor who is safe to hire answers quickly and specifically. They will not write a sentence into the document. They will not restructure a paragraph and hand it back. They will not supply the research question, the dataset or the news article. What they will do is teach the underlying skill, question the reasoning, point at a criterion and ask the student to reread their own paragraph against it. Notice that every one of those actions leaves the keyboard with the student.

There is a practical reason to be strict, beyond principle. The school submits the work and runs it through similarity checking, and malpractice findings are handled by the IB rather than by the school alone. A tutor who tidies the prose is not the one who carries that risk; your child is. Any tutor who treats the boundary as a formality has told you how they will behave in March, when the deadline is a week away and the draft is thin.
items: Ask which internal assessment type the tutor has supported, and how recently
Ask them to name your child's criteria, unprompted, in the first call
Ask what they will refuse to do with a draft, and listen carefully
Confirm identity, qualifications and subject claims before the first session
Watch a trial: does the tutor question the student, or dictate sentences?

contentBlocks.heading: The one draft a teacher may comment on, and the skills that carry across all three
contentBlocks.body:
Start with the rule, because everything else follows from it. Every IB internal assessment is the student's own work. The IB's academic integrity policy allows a teacher to give feedback on one draft; it does not allow anyone, tutor or parent, to write, rewrite or edit the student's submission. A tutor may teach the underlying skill, question the reasoning, point at a criterion and ask the student to reread their own paragraph against it. That is the whole permitted territory, and it is larger than it sounds.

The one draft is a single-use asset, and most families spend it badly. A student sends the teacher a half-finished piece in October to check whether the topic is acceptable, receives useful comments on an introduction that will be rewritten anyway, and then has nothing left to spend in January when the piece is finally complete and genuinely needs a reader. Submit the draft when the work is whole: rough in places, but complete from research question to conclusion. A complete rough version can be improved by a reader. An unfinished one only invites comments on what is missing, which the student already knows.

Now the part that makes these three tasks one skill rather than three. Narrowing a question until it can actually be answered is the same move in every subject: a scientific investigation with a measurable variable, an exploration with a mathematical question rather than a topic, a commentary about one article and one concept rather than about the whole economy. Justifying a choice is the same move again. So is honest self-criticism: Evaluation in the sciences, criterion D Reflection in mathematics, and the judgement a commentary passes on a policy are the same muscle, worked in three places.

Writing to a hard limit is the last transferable skill, and the most underrated. A maximum of 3,000 words, a 12-20 page exploration and three commentaries of up to 800 words each force different kinds of compression, and a student who learns to cut in one of them stops padding in the others. Personal engagement, criterion C in mathematics, is the one thing a tutor genuinely cannot supply, which is why topic choice is where good tutoring pays for itself.
items: One draft may receive teacher comment; that rule governs every internal assessment
A tutor may teach the skill, question reasoning and point at a criterion
Nobody, tutor or parent, may write, rewrite or edit the submission
Narrowing a question until it is answerable transfers between all three tasks
Writing to a hard limit is a skill, not a formatting chore

contentBlocks.heading: Your child is in DP2 with a late internal assessment. What actually helps now?
contentBlocks.body:
Triage in this order: fix the question, secure the raw material, write a complete rough version, then improve it. A DP2 student three weeks past an internal deadline does not need a better introduction. They need a finished bad version of the whole piece, because a complete draft can be worked on and an unfinished one cannot. This is the single most useful thing a tutor does in a late situation, and it is uncomfortable, because it means writing badly on purpose for a few days.

Progress in the first fortnight should look like a fixed research question and a workable plan, not polished prose. By the end of the first month there should be a complete rough version in the student's own words, ready for whatever draft the school permits. After that the work changes character entirely: reading the criteria against the student's own paragraphs, cutting to the word limit, and making the reflection honest rather than decorative. Families buying IB IA help in India in February should expect this shape, and should be suspicious of any plan that promises a polished piece without a rough one first.

The limits are worth saying out loud. A tutor cannot recover data that was never collected, and if the laboratory is closed and the trials do not exist, the conversation belongs with the teacher and the coordinator rather than with a tutor. A tutor cannot make a badly chosen news article yield a good commentary. A tutor cannot move a school deadline, and no tutor can guarantee a grade or a particular criterion score. Sometimes the honest recommendation is fewer tuition hours and two clear evenings, because an exhausted student writes nothing useful at eleven at night.

And there is a point at which tutoring should step back. Once the permitted draft is with the teacher, the internal assessment is largely out of everyone's hands, and hours are better spent on the externally assessed papers that carry the rest of the grade. A tutor who keeps selling coursework sessions after that point is selling reassurance, not teaching.

contentBlocks.heading: Booking home tuition for IB IA help in India: the first fortnight
contentBlocks.body:
Bring four things to the first session and it will not be wasted: the assignment brief the school issued, the published criteria for that internal assessment, the teacher's written feedback even if it runs to two lines, and whatever raw material already exists, whether that is a dataset, a page of working or three saved news articles. Also decide, before the session starts, whether the one commentable draft has been used, because the plan branches there.

The first session itself should end with a written question and a dated plan. Not encouragement, not a reading list. A plan that fits on one page and survives contact with a school week. Here is the sequence that works for any of the three tasks:

1. Fix the question. Narrow it until the student can say in one sentence what will be measured, explored or evaluated, and against which criterion that sentence will be judged.

2. Secure the raw material. Book the laboratory time, settle the mathematics to be used, or lock the three articles with their units and key concepts mapped out.

3. Write a complete rough version fast. Every section present, nothing polished, no gaps left for later. Speed matters more than quality at this stage.

4. Read it against the criteria with the student holding the pen. The descriptor first, then their own paragraph, then their own judgement about whether the two match.

5. Submit the one permitted draft only when the piece is whole, then treat the teacher's comments as a checklist rather than a verdict.

6. Cut to the word limit last, and check the presentation, citations and structure the criteria actually ask for.

That plan works for a scientific investigation, an exploration or a portfolio, which is the point. Sessions run at home, online or hybrid, subject to tutor availability, and the weekly rhythm should tighten as the deadline approaches and then stop once the draft is submitted.

faqs.question: Can a tutor help with my child's internal assessment without breaking the rules?
faqs.answer: Yes, within a boundary that is easy to state and easy to test. Every IB internal assessment is the student's own work, and nobody outside the school may write, rewrite or edit the submission. A tutor may teach the underlying skill, question the reasoning, point at a criterion and ask the student to reread their own paragraph against it. In practice that covers most of what a struggling student needs: a sharper question, a defensible method, and an honest evaluation. If a tutor offers to polish the writing for you, that is the moment to stop.

faqs.question: What is actually different between the three internal assessments my child is writing?
faqs.answer: The criteria, the length and the shape of the task. The sciences scientific investigation is worth 20% and is marked on four criteria of 6 marks each, Research design, Data analysis, Conclusion and Evaluation, with a maximum of 3,000 words. The mathematics exploration is also worth 20%, runs to 12-20 pages, and is marked out of 20 across five criteria. Economics is a portfolio of three commentaries of up to 800 words, each on a different unit and a different key concept. Same underlying skill, three very different containers.

faqs.question: Can a home tutor come to our flat in Powai on a weekday evening during deadline season?
faqs.answer: Usually yes, subject to tutor availability and to where the tutor is travelling from. Powai has reasonable local supply, and a tutor already on that side of the city holds an evening slot far more reliably than one crossing from Bandra or Worli after office hours. The practical advice is to fix a standing slot rather than booking week by week, because deadline season is exactly when ad hoc scheduling collapses. Many families in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region keep the home visit at the weekend and run shorter online checks midweek.

faqs.question: Is home tuition or online better once the deadline is close?
faqs.answer: Home tuition is better if the problem is starting, and online is better if the problem is understanding. A home tutor sees the desk, the half-finished file and the avoidance, and that visibility matters more in the last fortnight than at any other time. An online specialist matters more when your city has nobody who has supported that particular task. Most families end up hybrid: one home session a fortnight for the messy work, shorter online sessions between. Whichever you choose, get a session into this week rather than next.

faqs.question: My daughter's teacher has already commented on her draft. What can we do now?
faqs.answer: Work with what the comments already say, and do not expect a second round. The policy allows feedback on one draft, so once it is used the student is on their own for the final version, which is precisely when an outside tutor becomes useful within the rules. Turn the teacher's comments into a checklist, one line per point, and have your child work through them against the published criteria. A tutor can question whether each fix actually addresses the criterion, without touching the document itself.

faqs.question: We are in Gachibowli and cannot find an Economics tutor nearby. What are the options?
faqs.answer: Widen the search online rather than settling for a generalist. Hyderabad has decent density around Gachibowli, HITEC City, Madhapur and Kondapur for the common subjects, but a specific portfolio task can still leave you with nobody local who has read one. An online tutor who has supported many commentaries will do more for criterion work than a nearby tutor learning the task alongside your child. If you want someone in the room as well, a hybrid arrangement with a local generalist for study habits can work.

faqs.question: Is a group investigation allowed, and can three students submit the same report?
faqs.answer: Group work is allowed in the sciences, but the report is not. Students may investigate in groups of up to three, which is how most school laboratories are organised anyway, and the shared session produces shared raw data. Each student then writes an individual report. That means the research design commentary, the analysis, the conclusion and the evaluation must be the student's own thinking, even where the numbers are identical. Three near-identical reports from one group is exactly the pattern similarity checking is designed to surface.

faqs.question: What happens if something in the submitted work is flagged?
faqs.answer: The school submits the work and runs it through similarity checking, and malpractice findings are handled by the IB rather than by the school alone. That is why the boundary matters so much more here than in ordinary tuition: the consequence sits with the candidate, not with the tutor who helpfully rewrote a paragraph in March. Keep a simple habit through the whole process. Every sentence in the document was typed by the student, every source is cited, and the working files show the piece growing over weeks.

faqs.question: It is DP2 and the internal assessment is three weeks late. Is it worth starting tuition now?
faqs.answer: Yes, provided the sessions are used for triage rather than for teaching content. The order that works is: fix the question, secure the raw material, write a complete rough version quickly, then improve it against the criteria. A late student does not need a better opening paragraph, they need a finished piece to work on. Talk to the coordinator about the school deadline as well, because schools handle late coursework differently and you should know where you actually stand before paying for anything.

faqs.question: Does my child need a home tutor for every subject that has an internal assessment?
faqs.answer: Almost certainly not, and families buying three lots of IB IA help in India at once are making the common mistake. These tasks share a method, so one tutor who genuinely understands criterion-based coursework can lift the approach across all three, even while teaching only one subject. Start with the subject where the teacher's feedback is most worrying, and see whether the habits transfer. If a second subject still lags after a month, add support there. Three simultaneous home tuition commitments in DP2 usually leave a student with less writing time, not more.

faqs.question: How is IB IA help in India usually priced, and what should we agree upfront?
faqs.answer: Pricing is normally per session and varies with level, subject scarcity and whether the tutor travels to you, so treat any single figure quoted online with caution. What matters more is what you agree before starting: the length and frequency of sessions, whether an intensive block near the deadline is expected, how cancellations are handled, and what the tutor will report back to you. Fees usually rise for a scarce Higher Level specialist and for home visits across a large metro.

faqs.question: How do we judge whether tuition is working when there is no mark yet?
faqs.answer: Judge the artefacts, not the mood. After two weeks there should be a written research question your child can defend in one sentence. After a month there should be a complete rough version, however untidy. Ask your child to explain one criterion to you in their own words; if they can, the sessions are landing. If four weeks have produced encouragement, a reading list and no written work, the arrangement is not working, and you can ask for a different match.
