heroTitle: Chemistry Tuition for Grades 9 and 10 in India
heroSubtitle: Chemistry is the IGCSE science where marks leak quietly: a mole calculation started from the wrong equation, a bonding diagram missing an electron, a chemical test described but never explained. Home tutors matched through IB Gram teach Cambridge 0620 and Pearson Edexcel 4CH1 at your own table, with online and hybrid weeks where travel does not work.
introSummary: IGCSE Chemistry tutors in India teach Cambridge 0620 or Pearson Edexcel 4CH1 one to one, usually as weekly home tuition in the family's own locality, with online or hybrid weeks when traffic or exam season makes a visit impractical. Most Grade 9 and Grade 10 students who struggle in Chemistry are not struggling with all of it. They are losing marks in one narrow place: stoichiometry, and the mole in particular. A tutor who has marked enough scripts can usually find that within two sessions, by watching the student set out a calculation rather than by asking whether they understand it. This page explains what a good Chemistry tutor does with 0620 and 4CH1, how the practical papers are handled without a laboratory at home, and how to judge a tutor before you commit.

contentBlocks.heading: How is a 0620 or 4CH1 Chemistry tutor matched to your child in India?
contentBlocks.body:
You send one query that names the board and syllabus code, the exam series the school has entered, your locality and the two evenings that are genuinely free. IB Gram asks about level, the school calendar and the schedule you can hold, then shortlists tutors whose profiles are verified and match those needs. A demo or trial session can be arranged before the family commits to anything.

Chemistry makes that shortlist narrower than most parents expect. A tutor comfortable with Cambridge IGCSE Chemistry 0620 Extended is not automatically comfortable with Pearson Edexcel International GCSE Chemistry 4CH1, because the two boards set their practical assessment differently. Cambridge splits it into a Paper 5 practical test or a Paper 6 alternative to practical, chosen by the school, while Pearson Edexcel International GCSE sciences assess practical skills inside the written papers. Ask which of those a tutor has actually taught towards. The answer separates a general science tutor from someone who can prepare your child for the paper the school has entered them for.

The single most useful thing you can attach to a query is a marked script. Not a report card, not a term percentage. One question with your child's working still on it, preferably a stoichiometry question, because that is where the fault line usually runs. A tutor reading that page can tell in a minute whether the problem is the mole itself, the balanced equation that came before it, or arithmetic done in a hurry. Each of those needs a different first session, and a tutor who cannot tell them apart will spend a month teaching the wrong thing.

Matching is subject to tutor availability, and availability in Chemistry depends heavily on when you ask. Families who start looking in Grade 9 have a real choice of home tutors. Families who start in the weeks before a February/March series are choosing from whoever still has an evening slot left. If your locality has thin supply, say early that you would accept online or hybrid lessons. That widens the list immediately, and it costs you nothing to offer.

The steps below are what actually happens, in order.
items: 1. Send the syllabus code: Cambridge 0620 or Edexcel 4CH1, and the tier.
2. Name the series the school entered: February/March, May/June or October/November.
3. Say whether the school enters Paper 5 practical test or Paper 6 alternative.
4. Attach one marked Chemistry script, ideally a stoichiometry question with working visible.
5. Give two weekday evening windows and your locality, so home visits stay realistic.
6. Take a trial session, then ask for a different match if needed.

contentBlocks.heading: Cambridge 0620 or Edexcel 4CH1: which Chemistry course is your child actually sitting?
contentBlocks.body:
Look at the syllabus code printed on the exam entry or the front of the textbook. Cambridge IGCSE Chemistry is 0620 and the Pearson Edexcel International GCSE equivalent is 4CH1. They cover similar chemistry and are assessed differently enough that a tutor must know which one you are on before planning a single lesson.

Cambridge runs many subjects in two tiers. Core tops out at grade C. Extended reaches A*. Cambridge grades most syllabuses A* to G, and some syllabuses have 9 to 1 versions under different codes. Pearson Edexcel International GCSE is untiered and graded 9 to 1, so every candidate sits the same two papers. That difference is not academic. A Core Chemistry student and an Extended Chemistry student sitting in the same Grade 10 classroom need different past papers, different depth on stoichiometry, and often a different number of sessions a week.

For Cambridge sciences examined from 2023 the shape is fixed. Paper 1 is multiple choice for Core and Paper 2 is multiple choice for Extended. Paper 3 is theory for Core and Paper 4 is theory for Extended. Practical assessment comes through Paper 5, a practical test, or Paper 6, the alternative to practical, and the school chooses which one its candidates take. The weighting is multiple choice 30%, theory 50%, practical 20%. Read those three figures again, because they decide where tuition time should go. Half the grade sits in the theory paper. A fifth sits in a practical component that many students prepare for last, in the final fortnight, badly.

The calendar differs too. Cambridge exam series run in February/March, a series offered only in India, May/June and October/November. Pearson Edexcel International GCSE series run in January and May/June. A school entered for the February/March series compresses Grade 10 by a term, and Chemistry is usually the subject that feels it first, because organic chemistry and chemistry of the environment tend to sit late in the scheme of work. Confirm the series with the school's examinations office before you plan anything at all.

IGCSE in India normally means a two-year course across Grades 9 and 10, often followed by the International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma Programme (DP), Cambridge International AS and A Levels, or a move to CBSE or ISC in Class 11. Where your child is heading changes how much Chemistry depth is worth buying now.
items: Cambridge 0620 Core tops out at grade C; Extended reaches A*.
Pearson Edexcel 4CH1 is untiered and graded 9 to 1.
Cambridge science weighting: multiple choice 30%, theory 50%, practical 20%.
Paper 5 is a practical test; Paper 6 is the alternative to practical.
Cambridge series: February/March in India, May/June, and October/November.
Pearson Edexcel International GCSE series run in January and May/June.

contentBlocks.heading: Mole calculations: the 0620 topic where Chemistry marks quietly disappear
contentBlocks.body:
Cambridge IGCSE Chemistry 0620 covers states of matter; atoms, elements and compounds; stoichiometry including the mole; electrochemistry; chemical energetics; chemical reactions; acids, bases and salts; the Periodic Table; metals; chemistry of the environment; organic chemistry; and experimental techniques and chemical analysis. Pearson Edexcel 4CH1 covers the same ground under its own arrangement. Twelve areas, two years, and one of them quietly decides the grade.

Stoichiometry is that one. The mole turns up in questions that are not labelled stoichiometry: a titration inside acids, bases and salts, a yield question inside metals, a mass of product inside chemical reactions, an electrolysis calculation inside electrochemistry. A student who is shaky on the mole loses marks across four topics while believing they have a problem with one. This is the single topic IGCSE Chemistry tutors in India spend most of their time on, and the reason is arithmetic that behaves like grammar: get the first line wrong and every line below inherits it.

Here is the kind of question that separates students. Calculate the mass of magnesium oxide formed when 4.8 g of magnesium burns completely in oxygen.

1. Write and balance the equation: 2Mg + O2 gives 2MgO.

2. Read the relative atomic mass of magnesium from the Periodic Table supplied in the paper. It is 24.

3. Moles of magnesium = mass divided by relative atomic mass = 4.8 divided by 24 = 0.2 mol.

4. Take the ratio from the balanced equation. Magnesium to magnesium oxide is 2 : 2, so moles of magnesium oxide = 0.2 mol.

5. Relative formula mass of magnesium oxide = 24 + 16 = 40.

6. Mass = moles multiplied by relative formula mass = 0.2 multiplied by 40 = 8.0 g.

Most students who get this wrong do not fail at step 3. They fail at step 1 or step 4. They write Mg + O gives MgO, or they carry 0.2 straight to the answer without checking the ratio, or they use 16 for oxygen in a question that involves O2. A tutor sitting beside them sees which one it is. A parent looking at a red cross on a returned script cannot.

The same spine carries concentration, where moles equal concentration in mol per dm3 multiplied by volume in dm3, and percentage yield, and limiting reactant questions, and empirical formula from composition by mass. Drill it until the student writes the balanced equation first without being told. That habit alone recovers marks right across the theory paper, which carries half the grade.
items: Moles equal mass divided by relative atomic or formula mass.
Balance the equation first; an unbalanced equation loses every mark below it.
Concentration in mol per dm3 multiplied by volume in dm3 gives moles.
Take the mole ratio from the equation, never from the question wording.
Empirical formula, percentage yield and limiting reactant all reuse the same spine.
Ten minutes of written mole practice belongs in every single session.

contentBlocks.heading: IGCSE Chemistry home tuition across India, locality by locality
contentBlocks.body:
Chemistry home tuition works differently in different parts of India, and the difference is mostly about evenings. In Delhi NCR a tutor living in South Delhi can hold a six o'clock slot in Vasant Kunj or Chanakyapuri through the week, but the same tutor crossing to Sector 128 Noida or Faridabad on a weekday evening is making a promise that traffic will eventually break. Families in Gurugram along Golf Course Road, in Dwarka, in Greater Noida and in Ghaziabad usually do better with an IGCSE Chemistry tutor in Delhi NCR who lives on their own side of the city, even when another profile looks slightly more impressive.

In the Mumbai Metropolitan Region the arithmetic is harsher. A tutor in Bandra, Juhu or Andheri can serve Worli, Lower Parel and Malabar Hill on a good evening. Powai is its own world, and so are Thane, Navi Mumbai, Vashi and Kharghar. A family in Kharghar searching for an IGCSE Chemistry tutor in Mumbai should read that as a search across the whole region rather than an expectation that somebody will cross the harbour twice a week. Monsoon weeks decide the question for you anyway, which is why most families here settle into a hybrid pattern by the middle of Grade 10.

Bengaluru families in Whitefield, Sarjapur Road, HSR Layout and Electronic City are often closest to the international school and still far from the tutor, because a good part of the pool sits in Indiranagar, Koramangala and Jayanagar. Hebbal, Yelahanka and Kanakapura Road stretch it further, so an IGCSE Chemistry tutor in Bangalore is worth judging by where they live rather than by where they teach. Pune is kinder. Koregaon Park, Kalyani Nagar, Viman Nagar and Kharadi form one cluster, Baner, Balewadi, Aundh, Wakad and Hinjewadi form another, and an IGCSE Chemistry tutor in Pune who lives in the right cluster can hold a weekday evening slot honestly.

Gujarat is the case for widening a search early. Ahmedabad has real supply around Satellite, Bodakdev and SG Highway, and Gandhinagar is close enough for home visits to work. Surat, Vadodara and Rajkot are thinner, and a family there looking for an IGCSE Chemistry tutor in Ahmedabad is usually better served by an online specialist plus one home session a fortnight. The same reasoning covers an IGCSE Chemistry tutor in Hyderabad around Gachibowli and Jubilee Hills, an IGCSE Chemistry tutor in Chennai around Adyar and Old Mahabalipuram Road (OMR), and an IGCSE Chemistry tutor in Kolkata, where the international school population is smaller and the Chemistry pool smaller still.

Never plan around a travel time nobody has tested. Evening traffic between Whitefield and Indiranagar, or between Thane and Bandra, can stretch a short trip badly. Families comparing IGCSE Chemistry tutors in India should ask what time the tutor would leave home, not what time they expect to arrive.
items: Delhi NCR: match tutor and family to the same side of the city.
Mumbai Metropolitan Region: Thane, Navi Mumbai and Kharghar usually need a hybrid week.
Bengaluru: the tutor pool often sits away from the Whitefield and Sarjapur Road schools.
Pune: Koregaon Park and Baner are separate clusters for evening travel.
Gujarat: Ahmedabad has supply; Surat, Vadodara and Rajkot often go online.
Ask what time a tutor leaves, not what time they hope to arrive.

contentBlocks.heading: How the school calendar in India squeezes Chemistry revision
contentBlocks.body:
The pressure point in Chemistry is not the exam. It is the mock, and it lands earlier than most families expect. International schools in India typically run a full mock cycle several weeks before the series, and Chemistry mocks are often set across the whole syllabus while the class has not yet finished organic chemistry. A student can walk out of that mock with a grade that frightens the household and means very little.

IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school named here, the International Baccalaureate, Cambridge International Education or Pearson Edexcel. What follows describes the calendar families across India deal with in general, not the arrangements of any particular school.

The Indian school year makes its own demands. School timings, sport and the long list of activities Grade 9 students are encouraged into leave weekday evenings crowded. Then the Diwali break arrives, then the winter break, and for a school entered for the February/March series those breaks are the last uninterrupted study blocks before the papers. Home tuition scheduled for eight in the evening after a full school day rarely produces good Chemistry. A tutor who asks for a Saturday morning slot instead is usually right, and a tutor who accepts any slot you offer without comment has not thought about it.

Coursework is not the burden in IGCSE Chemistry that it is in some subjects, which is a relief for a Grade 10 timetable. The practical component is, and it is scheduled by the school rather than by you. If the school enters Paper 5, laboratory sessions at school are the only place those skills can be built, and tuition should support that work rather than duplicate it. If the school enters Paper 6, preparation is entirely paper-based and can happen at your dining table on a weekday evening.

Ask the school three things before hiring anyone: which syllabus code, which tier, and which practical paper. Coordinators answer that readily and usually in one email. A tutor who guesses those answers is guessing your child's revision plan along with them.
items: Confirm syllabus code, tier and practical paper with the school coordinator first.
Mocks often cover topics the class has not yet been taught.
Diwali and winter breaks are the last clear blocks before February/March.
An eight o'clock weekday session after a full school day rarely works.
Paper 5 laboratory skills belong at school, not in a tuition session.

contentBlocks.heading: Home, online or hybrid: which mode suits Chemistry practical preparation?
contentBlocks.body:
IGCSE Chemistry tutors in India work in three modes, and for this subject the choice is genuinely consequential. Home tuition puts a tutor beside the student's written working, which is where Chemistry marks are actually won and lost. Online tuition reaches a specialist who does not live in your city and makes annotating a mark scheme on screen straightforward. Hybrid keeps a good tutor when traffic or exam season makes a weekly visit impossible. The trade-off is simple: presence catches the silent errors, and distance buys you a better teacher.

Presence matters more in Chemistry than parents assume. Dot-and-cross diagrams, energy level diagrams, apparatus drawings, half-equations and state symbols are all written objects. A tutor at the table sees the electron missed from the outer shell, the arrow drawn the wrong way round, the state symbol left off a balanced equation. On a screen, that same page arrives as a photograph taken at an angle, after the mistake has already been made and often after the student has rubbed out the evidence.

One thing home tuition does not include is chemical experiments. No reputable tutor will bring reagents into your flat, and you should be wary of one who offers to. There is no fume cupboard, no proper disposal, no eyewash, and nobody trained to deal with a spill. The marks in 0620 and 4CH1 are not awarded for performing a reaction anyway. They are awarded for describing a method, reading a scale, recording results in a sensible table, spotting an anomalous value and suggesting an improvement. A safe molecular model kit, a whiteboard and a stack of past papers do more for a Chemistry grade than anything that could be safely attempted in a kitchen.

Chemical tests are learned the same way, on paper and out loud. Limewater turning milky for carbon dioxide. A lighted splint and a squeaky pop for hydrogen. A glowing splint relighting for oxygen. Damp red litmus turning blue for ammonia. The white, cream and yellow precipitates acidified silver nitrate gives with chloride, bromide and iodide. The white precipitate barium ions give with sulfate. The coloured hydroxide precipitates that separate copper two, iron two and iron three. Students who have seen every one of these in the school laboratory still lose the marks, because the question asks for the observation and the conclusion and they write only one of the two.

Paper 6, the alternative to practical, rewards exactly this kind of work: reading a burette to the right precision, plotting points and drawing a line of best fit, naming the anomalous reading instead of ignoring it, identifying a variable that should have been controlled, and giving a safety precaution with a reason attached to it. All of that can be taught in home classes, and most of it transfers to online lessons without loss. A hybrid week of one home session and one online session covers both sides of the subject well.
items: Home tutors read the working as it is written, not afterwards.
Online reaches a 0620 or 4CH1 specialist who lives in another city.
Hybrid: one home session and one online session in the same week.
No tutor should bring chemical reagents into a family home, ever.
Paper 6 is entirely paper-based and suits home lessons very well.
Chemical tests need observation and conclusion; students usually write only one.

contentBlocks.heading: How do you check IGCSE Chemistry tutors in India before the first lesson?
contentBlocks.body:
IGCSE Chemistry tutors in India reach a family shortlist only after their profiles are verified, but no platform can sit in your living room. Run three checks yourself in the trial session, and none of them takes long: ask which syllabus code they have taught, ask them to mark one question in front of you, and ask what they would do in the first month.

The syllabus code question is the quickest filter there is. A tutor who teaches Chemistry in general says Chemistry. An IGCSE 0620 tutor says 0620, then asks whether you are Core or Extended, then asks whether the school enters Paper 5 or Paper 6. An Edexcel 4CH1 tutor says 4CH1 and mentions that practical skills are assessed inside the written papers there. Anyone who treats Cambridge and Pearson Edexcel as interchangeable has taught only one of them, whatever the profile says.

The marking test is better still. Hand over your child's marked stoichiometry answer and ask the tutor to talk through where the marks went. A good one reads the working line by line and says something specific: the equation was not balanced, so every figure below it inherited the error, and the mark scheme would still have credited the method if the wrong value had been carried forward consistently. A weak one says the student needs more practice and changes the subject.

Then the checks that have nothing to do with chemistry. Confirm who is coming to your house, by name. Confirm that the same person teaches every week rather than a rotating panel. Agree in writing how a missed session is handled and how much notice each side gives. For a home tutor, sort out society gate entry before the first visit, because a tutor turned away at the gate twice will quietly stop coming and nobody will tell you why.

None of this is rude, and serious tutors expect it. The ones who bristle at being asked to mark a single question in front of a parent have told you something useful about the year ahead.
items: Ask which code: 0620 Core, 0620 Extended, or Edexcel 4CH1.
Ask the tutor to mark one stoichiometry answer in front of you.
Confirm the same tutor teaches every week, not a rotating panel.
Agree missed-session and notice rules in writing before the first month.
Arrange society gate entry before the first home visit, not during it.

contentBlocks.heading: What one hour of Chemistry home tuition should actually contain
contentBlocks.body:
An hour of Chemistry does not fit a whole topic, and tutors who try to cover one end up delivering a lecture the student has forgotten by Thursday. A one-hour home session should do five things and finish at least one of them properly. Here is a shape that works for both 0620 and 4CH1.

1. Five minutes on the error log. The student reads out the last three mistakes and says what each one was, not what the right answer was.

2. Ten minutes of mole practice, in every session, whatever the topic of the week. Short, timed, written out in full.

3. Twenty-five minutes on the topic itself, taught with something physical on the table: a molecular model kit for bonding and structure, a printed Periodic Table, a drawn energy level diagram.

4. Fifteen minutes of exam questions on that topic, done in silence while the tutor watches the working rather than the final answer.

5. Five minutes setting homework that is one page long and due before the next session.

Step 3 is where bonding and structure is won. Ionic bonding is electron transfer, and a student who has pushed two model atoms together and physically moved an electron across never again writes that sodium shares an electron with chlorine. Covalent bonding is a shared pair, and a model shows why simple molecular substances melt easily while diamond and silicon dioxide, built as giant covalent structures, do not. Metallic bonding is a lattice of positive ions in a sea of delocalised electrons, which explains electrical conduction and malleability in one picture. None of this needs a laboratory. It needs a model kit, a pencil, and a tutor who asks the student to draw it rather than drawing it for them.

The proportions shift through the two years. In the final weeks before a series, step 4 grows and step 3 shrinks to almost nothing. In Grade 9, step 3 is the whole point and step 4 is a formality. But the mole practice in step 2 never comes out of the hour, in either year, in any week, however well the student seems to be doing.
items: Five minutes reading the error log aloud at the start.
Ten minutes of written mole practice, every session without exception.
Twenty-five minutes of teaching with a model kit or printed Periodic Table.
Fifteen minutes of exam questions with the tutor watching the working.
One page of homework, set at the end, due before next time.

contentBlocks.heading: How long does it take to fix mole calculations, and what changes first?
contentBlocks.body:
Expect four to six weeks before a mole calculation stops causing panic, and expect the first visible change to appear in the working rather than in the mark. Around week two the student starts writing the balanced equation without being asked. Around week four they check the ratio before dividing. The grade moves later, and it moves in the theory paper first, because that is where the calculation marks live.

The instrument that makes progress visible is an error log. One page, three columns: the question, what went wrong, and the corrected method in the student's own handwriting. After a month it tells you more than any report does. If the same error appears four times, the teaching has not landed, and the tutor should change approach rather than repeat the old explanation more loudly.

Organic chemistry produces its own recurring set of errors, and they are worth naming because parents hear them as carelessness when they are conceptual. Students confuse a homologous series with a set of isomers. They learn the general formula for alkanes and then apply it to alkenes. They say alkanes undergo addition, when alkanes substitute and alkenes add. They forget that bromine water is decolourised by an alkene and stays orange with an alkane, so the test reports on the double bond and nothing else. They mix up the two routes to ethanol, fermentation and the addition of steam to ethene, and cannot say which of the two runs as a continuous process. And they name esters backwards. Each of those is one focused session, not a term of extra classes.

The honest limits of IGCSE Chemistry tutors in India are worth stating plainly. A student who has missed a term of school cannot be caught up in a month of weekly sessions, and a tutor who says otherwise is selling something. No tutor can guarantee a grade, and any promise about a specific grade should be treated with real scepticism. A student who is behind in every subject does not have a Chemistry problem. And a Grade 10 student who has never read a mark scheme needs exam technique before more content.

Review every six weeks. Ask what has come off the error log, not what has been covered.
items: Four to six weeks before mole calculations stop causing real panic.
The working changes before the mark does; read the script, not the grade.
Error log: the question, what went wrong, the corrected method in handwriting.
Alkanes substitute and alkenes add: the confusion behind many organic marks.
Bromine water is decolourised by an alkene and stays orange with alkanes.
Review every six weeks and ask what has left the error log.

contentBlocks.heading: Getting started with IGCSE Chemistry tutors in India
contentBlocks.body:
Before you send anything, gather four things: the syllabus code, the tier, the practical paper the school enters, and one marked Chemistry script with the working still visible on it. That is a five-minute job and it improves the quality of every conversation that follows.

IGCSE Chemistry tutors in India are engaged through a short process. You send a query or book a free consultation. IB Gram asks about board, syllabus, level, the school calendar, your location and the schedule you can genuinely hold, then shortlists tutors whose profiles are verified and match those needs. A demo or trial session can be arranged before the family commits. Lessons run at home, online or hybrid, subject to tutor availability in your area. If the fit is wrong after two or three sessions, ask for a different match; that is an ordinary request, not a complaint.

The first session should not be a lesson. It should be a diagnosis. A good Chemistry tutor spends it watching the student attempt work rather than explaining anything: a short stoichiometry question, a bonding diagram drawn from memory, one structured question from a past theory paper, and a Paper 6 style question about reading a scale and identifying an anomaly. They should finish with two or three specific findings and a plan for the first month, and they should tell you which topic they are leaving alone for now.

Start earlier than feels necessary. A Grade 9 student with one home session a week builds the mole habit while there is time to build it slowly, and by Grade 10 usually needs less help rather than more. A Grade 10 student starting in the term before a February/March series is doing triage, and triage means choosing which topics to abandon. Both are legitimate purchases. They are not the same purchase, and the second one should be described honestly by whoever sells it to you.

One last thing. If your child's real difficulty is reading the question rather than the chemistry, say so in the query. That is a different tutor and a different plan.
items: Bring the syllabus code, the tier, the practical paper and a marked script.
The first session is a diagnosis, not a lesson.
A demo or trial session can be arranged before the family commits.
Ask for a different match if the fit is wrong.
Lessons run at home, online or hybrid, subject to tutor availability.

faqs.question: Why does my child understand Chemistry in class but lose marks on mole calculations?
faqs.answer: Because understanding a concept and executing a multi-step calculation under time pressure are different skills, and the mole needs the second one. A student can explain what a mole is and still write an unbalanced equation, take the wrong ratio, or drop a unit. Marks in stoichiometry are lost in sequence, so one error at the start carries through every line below it. The fix is short, written, timed practice in every session, with the tutor watching the working rather than checking only the final answer.

faqs.question: Will an IGCSE Chemistry home tutor do experiments with my child at home?
faqs.answer: No, and you should be wary of a tutor who offers to. A flat has no fume cupboard, no safe disposal and no eyewash, and neither 0620 nor 4CH1 awards marks for performing a reaction at your dining table. The marks go to describing a method, reading a scale precisely, tabulating results, identifying an anomalous value and suggesting an improvement. Practical chemistry belongs in the school laboratory, particularly if the school enters Paper 5. Tuition supports that work with diagrams, model kits and past questions.

faqs.question: We are in Powai and most tutors seem to be in Bandra. Is a weekday home visit realistic?
faqs.answer: Possibly once a week, rarely twice. Evening traffic across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region can stretch a short trip badly, and a tutor who agrees to two weekday evenings in Powai from Bandra is usually agreeing to something that breaks by the second month. The pattern most families settle on is one home session at a weekend or early evening plus one online session midweek. Ask the tutor what time they would leave rather than what time they expect to arrive, and plan for the monsoon before it starts.

faqs.question: How does a tutor prepare a student for Paper 6, the alternative to practical?
faqs.answer: Entirely on paper, which is why it suits tuition at home so well. Preparation means reading burettes, thermometers and measuring cylinders to the correct precision, drawing and labelling apparatus, tabulating results, plotting graphs and drawing a line of best fit, naming the anomalous point instead of ignoring it, identifying controlled variables, and giving a safety precaution with a reason attached. Past Paper 6 questions are worked under timed conditions and marked against the mark scheme line by line. Confirm first whether the school enters Paper 5 or Paper 6.

faqs.question: Should my child take Core or Extended Chemistry, and who decides?
faqs.answer: The school makes the entry, usually on evidence from marked work, and in Chemistry the decision is often taken later than in other subjects. What the tier means is concrete: Cambridge Core tops out at grade C and Extended reaches A*. So the decision narrows what is available to a student who will need a strong Chemistry grade for a science pathway later. A tutor's job is to produce evidence for that conversation, in the form of marked Extended past paper questions. Pearson Edexcel 4CH1 is untiered, so the question does not arise there.

faqs.question: My child keeps mixing up alkanes and alkenes. Is that just a memory problem?
faqs.answer: It is usually a conceptual problem wearing a memory costume. Alkanes are saturated and undergo substitution; alkenes contain a carbon to carbon double bond and undergo addition. Once a student has built both with a model kit and seen what the double bond changes, the two sets of reactions stop being lists to memorise. The bromine water test then follows naturally: an alkene decolourises bromine water and an alkane leaves it orange. One focused session on the double bond often clears several weeks of confusion in organic chemistry.

faqs.question: Can one tutor cover Chemistry for both Cambridge 0620 and Pearson Edexcel 4CH1?
faqs.answer: Often yes, but ask rather than assume. The chemistry content overlaps heavily, so a strong teacher moves between the two without difficulty. The assessment does not overlap as cleanly. Cambridge tiers Core and Extended and assesses practical work through Paper 5 or Paper 6, while Pearson Edexcel International GCSE is untiered with Paper 1 and Paper 2 and assesses practical skills inside the written papers. Grading differs too, A* to G against 9 to 1. A tutor who cannot describe that difference has taught only one board.

faqs.question: Does online Chemistry tuition really work as well as a tutor in the room?
faqs.answer: For some parts of the syllabus it works just as well, and for others it does not. Mark scheme reading, past paper annotation, Paper 6 technique and organic chemistry explanation all transfer to a screen without much loss. What suffers is the silent error: the electron missed from a dot-and-cross diagram, the state symbol left off, the half-equation written the wrong way round. A tutor at the table catches those as they happen. Many families in Bengaluru and Hyderabad run a hybrid week for exactly this reason.

faqs.question: We are in Ahmedabad and cannot find an IGCSE Chemistry tutor nearby. What should we do?
faqs.answer: Widen the search deliberately instead of settling for a general science tutor. Around Satellite, Bodakdev and SG Highway there is real supply, and Gandhinagar is close enough for home visits to work, so start there. If nothing fits, an online 0620 or 4CH1 specialist based in another city, paired with one home session a fortnight for written work, usually beats a nearby tutor who has never taught the syllabus. Families in Surat, Vadodara and Rajkot reach the same conclusion faster, and it is the right one.

faqs.question: How many home tuition sessions a week does a Grade 10 Chemistry student need?
faqs.answer: One or two, depending on how far behind the student is and what else they are carrying that term. One weekly home session plus honest independent practice is enough for a student who is coping but losing calculation marks. Two suits a student with a genuine content gap across several topics, and even then the second session should be the shorter of the pair. Three sessions a week in one subject usually signals something else, most often weak exam technique or too little sleep. Availability depends on level and schedule.

faqs.question: What should we see after a month, and what if we see nothing at all?
faqs.answer: After a month you should see changed working rather than a changed grade. Look for the balanced equation written first without prompting, the mole ratio checked before dividing, units carried through the calculation, and an error log with entries crossed off. If none of that has happened, say so directly at a review. A good tutor will change approach; if the same explanation simply arrives louder, ask for a different match. A month with no visible change in the working is enough evidence to act on.

comparison.heading: One-to-one, school teacher, batch or self-study: how should Chemistry be supported in India?
comparison.intro: Most families end up with a combination rather than a choice. The school teacher and the laboratory are fixed; what you are really deciding is what to add. A one-to-one tutor buys attention on your child's own working, a batch buys peer discussion at a lower cost per hour, and disciplined self-study with past papers buys time back. The deciding question is whether the problem is a content gap or a practice gap.

introSummary: IGCSE Biology tutors in India are hired for one problem more than any other: the 0610 syllabus is long, and a student who follows every lesson in class still cannot hold twenty-one topics in their head by the time the exam series arrives. Home tuition is the usual fix, because it turns a syllabus into a dated schedule and then holds the student to it. The work itself is specific. Learn the definitions in the exact words the mark scheme is reading for. Draw the standard diagrams until the labels are automatic. Practise the practical paper skills, which can be built at the dining table with no laboratory at all. This page sets out how that plan is made for Cambridge 0610 and Pearson Edexcel International GCSE Biology 4BI1, city by city.

contentBlocks.heading: How does IB Gram shortlist IGCSE Biology tutors in India?
contentBlocks.body:
You send one query naming the board, the tier and the topics that are going wrong, and IB Gram comes back with verified tutor profiles that match, with a demo session offered before you commit to anything. Most of the exchange happens over messages and one short call, and it is the detail in your first message that decides how good the shortlist is.

What separates a Biology request from a general science one is the syllabus. Cambridge IGCSE Biology 0610 and Pearson Edexcel International GCSE Biology 4BI1 are not interchangeable, and a teacher who has taught one for years may never have sat down with the other's papers. So the intake question is never simply 'a Biology tutor for Grade 10'. It is which board, which tier, which practical component the school has entered the cohort for, and which topics came back weakest in the last set of marked work.

Ask for the demo to be run on a real weakness rather than a general introduction. Send the tutor an answer your child has written, ideally an extended-response question from a past paper where marks were lost, and ask them to teach that single question for twenty minutes. You will learn more from those twenty minutes than from any profile. A tutor who reaches for the mark scheme, reads the marking points aloud and shows your child exactly where the words were missing is doing the job properly. A tutor who simply re-explains the biology, more slowly, is not.

If the fit is wrong after two or three sessions, say so and ask for a different match. That is a normal request rather than a complaint, and the earlier it comes the less time is lost. Matching depends on tutor availability in your locality and on the slot you need, so a weekday evening in a dense suburb takes longer to fill than a weekend morning.
items: 1. You send the board, tier, grade and the topics going wrong.
2. IB Gram asks about school calendar, mock dates, locality and workable slots.
3. Verified profiles teaching 0610 or 4BI1 are shortlisted, subject to availability.
4. A demo or trial session is arranged before the family commits.
5. Lessons run at home, online or hybrid, and the match can change.

contentBlocks.heading: Core or Extended 0610, and what the tier decides for Biology
contentBlocks.body:
Cambridge IGCSE Biology 0610 is tiered. Core candidates sit one set of papers and can reach grade C at best; Extended candidates sit the harder set and can reach A*. Pearson Edexcel International GCSE Biology 4BI1 is untiered, so every candidate sits the same papers and is graded 9-1. That one structural difference changes what tutoring has to do first.

For a 0610 student, the tier is the first real conversation. It is the school's entry decision, made from evidence, and it should be revisited each term rather than fixed in Grade 9. Core is not a soft option; it is a narrower syllabus with a ceiling. A student parked on Core in September because one test went badly can find in January that the ceiling now blocks a Class 11 or Diploma Programme plan that needs a strong science grade. A tutor's job here is to produce evidence either way: marked Extended past-paper sections, done under time, across several weeks, so the decision rests on scripts rather than impressions.

Cambridge grades most syllabuses A* to G, and some syllabuses exist in 9-1 versions under different codes, so check which code the school has actually entered. Edexcel International GCSE grades 9-1.

The exam series matter as much as the tier. Cambridge runs February/March, which is offered only in India, May/June and October/November. Edexcel runs January and May/June. A February/March entry compresses Grade 10 hard, because everything a May/June cohort does in the spring has to happen before the winter break instead. If your child is entered for February/March, the Biology plan has to start early in Grade 9 and stay ahead of the class, since there is no spring term left to rescue it.

IGCSE Biology usually runs across Grades 9 and 10 and then feeds into the IB Diploma Programme (DP), Cambridge International AS and A Levels, or a move to CBSE or ISC in Class 11. Say which of those you expect, because it changes which topics deserve extra depth now.
items: Core 0610 tops out at grade C; Extended reaches A*.
Edexcel 4BI1 is untiered and graded 9-1, with no tier decision.
Cambridge series: February/March in India, May/June and October/November.
Pearson Edexcel International GCSE series run in January and May/June.
Revisit the tier each term using marked Extended past-paper sections.

contentBlocks.heading: Paper 1 to Paper 6: where 0610 Biology marks are actually won
contentBlocks.body:
Cambridge IGCSE sciences examined from 2023 are assessed across three components, and the weighting tells you where the hours should go: multiple choice carries 30% of the marks, theory carries 50%, and the practical component carries 20%. Core candidates sit Paper 1, multiple choice, and Paper 3, theory. Extended candidates sit Paper 2, multiple choice, and Paper 4, theory. The practical assessment is either Paper 5, a practical test, or Paper 6, the alternative to practical, and the school chooses which. Ask the coordinator which one your child is entered for, because preparing for the wrong one wastes months. Pearson Edexcel 4BI1 has Paper 1 and Paper 2, with practical skills assessed inside the written papers. This is the split that IGCSE Biology tutors in India plan around.

Half the marks sit in theory, and theory in Biology is a writing test. That is the part students trained on numerical subjects underestimate. A child can know perfectly well that alveoli have a large surface area and still score almost nothing, because the question asked how gas exchange is made efficient and the mark scheme wants surface area, thin walls, a moist lining, a good blood supply and a maintained concentration gradient, each as a separate marking point.

Definitions are marked as wording, not as understanding. Osmosis, diffusion, active transport, respiration, transpiration: each has a form of words the examiner is reading for, with particular terms carrying the marks. Write the version from the syllabus your school follows on a card, then have the student reproduce it from memory once a week until it comes out intact under pressure.

Labelled diagrams carry marks of their own, and they are cheap marks thrown away by habit. A heart with the ventricles unlabelled. A nephron with the loop drawn but not named. A leaf cross-section with the palisade layer in the wrong place. Each costs a mark the student had already earned in their head. Label lines should be ruled, should touch the structure, and should never cross.
items: Multiple choice 30%, theory 50%, practical component 20% of the marks.
Extended sits Paper 2 multiple choice and Paper 4 theory.
Core sits Paper 1 multiple choice and Paper 3 theory.
Practical is Paper 5 or Paper 6, and the school chooses.
Edexcel 4BI1: Paper 1 and Paper 2, practical skills assessed within them.

contentBlocks.heading: Finding a 0610 home tutor in your part of India
contentBlocks.body:
IGCSE Biology tutors in India cluster where the international schools are, so the honest answer to a search for an IGCSE Biology tutor near me depends heavily on the suburb you are typing it from. In the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, families in Bandra, Juhu, Andheri, Worli, Lower Parel and Malabar Hill sit near a workable pool. Powai, Thane, Navi Mumbai, Vashi and Kharghar usually mean the tutor crosses the city, and evening traffic on a weekday can stretch a short trip badly, so a six o'clock slot in Kharghar is harder to hold than the same slot in Juhu. A parent looking for an IGCSE Biology tutor in Mumbai should ask where the tutor lives before asking anything else.

Bengaluru splits the same way. Whitefield, Sarjapur Road and Electronic City are their own worlds on a Tuesday evening, and a tutor based in Indiranagar, Koramangala, HSR Layout or Jayanagar will not always take them. Hebbal, Yelahanka and Kanakapura Road sit at the other edges. An IGCSE Biology tutor in Bangalore who lives inside the same corridor keeps the slot; one who does not starts cancelling by October.

Hyderabad is kinder in parts. Gachibowli, HITEC City, Madhapur, Kondapur, Financial District and Kokapet form one working belt, while Jubilee Hills, Banjara Hills and Secunderabad form another, and an IGCSE Biology tutor in Hyderabad who moves easily between the two is rarer than you would expect. In Chennai, Adyar, Besant Nagar, Alwarpet and Nungambakkam make one cluster, Old Mahabalipuram Road (OMR), Perungudi and Velachery another, with Anna Nagar apart from both. An IGCSE Biology tutor in Chennai from the OMR stretch will rarely come to Anna Nagar twice a week.

Across southern India beyond Bengaluru and Chennai, in Kochi, Thiruvananthapuram, Coimbatore, Mysuru, Mangaluru, Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada and Madurai, local 0610 supply thins quickly and a hybrid week is usually the realistic answer. The same holds for an IGCSE Biology tutor in Pune outside Koregaon Park, in Delhi NCR beyond the main school corridors, and for parents hunting an IGCSE Biology tutor in Kolkata or an IGCSE Biology tutor in Ahmedabad. A home tutor twenty minutes away is worth more in Grade 10 than a stronger one across the city, because the nearby one still arrives in monsoon week.
items: Bandra, Juhu and Andheri sit near a workable Mumbai tutor pool.
Whitefield, Sarjapur Road and Electronic City rarely share tutors with Indiranagar.
Gachibowli, HITEC City and Kondapur form one belt; Jubilee Hills another.
Adyar, Besant Nagar and OMR are separate Chennai evening commutes.
Kochi, Coimbatore and Visakhapatnam usually need an online or hybrid week.

contentBlocks.heading: The Grade 10 Biology calendar at international schools in India
contentBlocks.body:
Most international schools in India open the academic year around June or July and close in March or April, which puts a long Biology syllabus under a particular kind of pressure. Grade 9 feels roomy. Grade 10 does not. Between the Diwali break and the winter holidays the school is running mocks, the Biology teacher is still finishing the later units, and the student is being asked to revise material from fourteen months earlier that nobody has mentioned since.

Names such as Dhirubhai Ambani International School, Jamnabai Narsee School, Aditya Birla World Academy, B. D. Somani International School, Greenwood High International School, Canadian International School Bangalore, Chirec International School, Sreenidhi International School, Mercedes-Benz International School and Singapore International School come up constantly in these conversations. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school named here, the International Baccalaureate (IB), Cambridge International Education or Pearson Edexcel.

The pressure points repeat from family to family. The first is the October or November mock, usually the first time a student meets a full theory paper and discovers that recall was never the problem, writing to the marking points is. The second is the gap between what the class has covered and what the paper covers, because teachers sequence a long syllabus differently and three or four topics are often still ahead of the student when that first mock lands. The third is the February/March series, which for a Cambridge cohort in India removes the entire spring term from the plan.

Talk to the subject teacher before hiring anybody. Ask which topics remain, in what order they will be taught, which practical component the cohort is entered for, and what the last marked script actually showed. A home tutor who begins with those four answers can build a schedule that runs alongside the school. A home tutor without them will re-teach whatever the class did last week, which is the most common way tuition money is quietly wasted.
items: Ask which topics remain and in which order they will be taught.
Confirm whether the cohort sits Paper 5 or Paper 6.
October and November mocks expose writing, not recall.
A February/March entry removes the spring term from the plan.
In Grade 10, Diwali and winter breaks are revision blocks, not holidays.

contentBlocks.heading: Home, online or hybrid for 0610 practical work in India?
contentBlocks.body:
For Biology the mode matters less than for most subjects, with one exception: the practical component. Paper 5 and Paper 6 both test skills rather than laboratory flair, and nearly all of those skills can be built at a dining table. Reading a method and naming the independent, dependent and controlled variables. Building a results table with units in the column heading. Plotting a graph, choosing a sensible scale, drawing a line of best fit. Describing a trend and then explaining it. Naming a source of error and proposing an improvement that would genuinely reduce it. None of that needs equipment. What does need it is handling apparatus under time, and if your child sits Paper 5 the school laboratory is where that has to happen.

Home sessions give a tutor two things a screen does not: the student's real handwriting and their real diagrams, drawn in front of them, with a ruler or without one. Biology is full of silent losses, and a tutor sitting beside a student catches them in the moment.

Online wins on supply. A specialist in Edexcel 4BI1 may live in another city altogether, and for families in Kochi, Coimbatore or Visakhapatnam that is often the only route to one. Online is also steadier: no traffic, no evening lost to rain, and a shared screen is a good place to read a mark scheme line by line with the student.

Hybrid is where most Grade 10 families land. One home session a week for written work and diagrams, one online session for question practice and going through a marked script, and the freedom to move the online one when a school event swallows the evening. The trade-off is plain. A home session catches more and costs more travelling time; an online session reaches further and misses the small physical habits; hybrid gives up a little of each in exchange for a week the household can actually hold.
items: Home sessions catch handwriting, rushed diagrams and silent method losses.
Online reaches an Edexcel 4BI1 specialist living in another city.
Hybrid: one home lesson weekly, one online for question practice.
Paper 5 apparatus handling still needs the school laboratory.
Variables, tables, graphs and errors can be practised without equipment.

contentBlocks.heading: How do you check an Edexcel 4BI1 tutor's subject knowledge?
contentBlocks.body:
Ask them to do the job in front of you for twenty minutes, on Biology rather than on teaching in general. A profile on IB Gram is verified before it goes live, covering identity, the qualifications claimed, and the boards and syllabuses the tutor teaches, and that is where a platform's knowledge stops. Treat it as a filter rather than a verdict, because no document shows whether a particular adult will teach your particular child well.

So run three checks yourself in the demo. First, ask them to define active transport, and then ask which words in their definition carry the marks. Somebody who knows 0610 will separate the biology from the marking: movement against a concentration gradient, the carrier protein, the energy released by respiration. Somebody who waves at the idea and says the student 'just needs to understand it' has not opened a mark scheme recently.

Second, give them a marked answer your child has written, ideally a six-mark explanation question, and watch what they do with it. The right move is to find the marking points, show which ones are present, and put a finger on the sentence where a mark was available and missed. Encouragement without a mark scheme is worth nothing here.

Third, ask what they would do about diagrams. A 0610 or 4BI1 tutor should answer immediately: the standard diagrams, drawn repeatedly from memory, labelled with ruled lines, checked against the textbook version rather than against a feeling.

Then check the ordinary things, which matter more across two years than any of the above. Whether the tutor can hold the same weekday slot from now until the exam series. Whether they write down what was covered. Whether they will speak to you every few weeks and say something more useful than 'she is improving'. And whether you can ask for a different match, without awkwardness, if the fit turns out to be wrong.
items: Ask the tutor to define active transport and name the marking words.
Hand over your child's marked script and watch how they mark it.
Check which syllabus code and tier they have actually taught before.
Ask how progress will be reported to you every few weeks.
Confirm they can hold the same slot until the exam series.

contentBlocks.heading: Twenty-one topics in two years: how a Biology plan is built in India
contentBlocks.body:
The size of the list is the problem. Cambridge IGCSE Biology 0610 covers characteristics and classification of living organisms; organisation of the organism; movement into and out of cells; biological molecules; enzymes; plant nutrition; human nutrition; transport in plants; transport in animals; diseases and immunity; gas exchange in humans; respiration; excretion in humans; coordination and response; drugs; reproduction; inheritance; variation and selection; organisms and their environment; human influences on ecosystems; and biotechnology and genetic modification. Pearson Edexcel 4BI1 covers the equivalent ground. Twenty-one areas, two years, and not one of them is individually hard.

That is exactly why students come unstuck. Nothing on the list defeats a capable Grade 9 student on the day it is taught. The failure is cumulative. Characteristics and classification is taught in the first month of Grade 9 and never mentioned again until the mock. Enzymes are understood in October and gone by March. By the time inheritance arrives in Grade 10, the student is quietly carrying nine topics they could not write a decent paragraph on.

A working plan therefore runs two tracks at once, and IGCSE Biology tutors in India who are any good will insist on both.

The first track is coverage, tied to the school's own sequence. Roughly: Grade 9 term one takes characteristics and classification, organisation of the organism, movement into and out of cells, biological molecules and enzymes. Term two takes plant nutrition, human nutrition, transport in plants and transport in animals. Term three takes diseases and immunity, gas exchange in humans and respiration. Grade 10 term one takes excretion in humans, coordination and response, and drugs. Term two takes reproduction, inheritance, and variation and selection. Term three takes organisms and their environment, human influences on ecosystems, and biotechnology and genetic modification, and then the coverage track stops and revision begins.

The second track is return. Every single week, one old topic comes back as a timed past-paper section, marked against the mark scheme, and logged. Across two school years that brings every topic back three or four times, which is the thing that actually moves a Biology grade.
items: Twenty-one topic areas across two years, none of them individually difficult.
Coverage track follows the school's own sequence, term by term.
Return track revisits one older topic weekly under timed conditions.
Every returned topic is marked against the mark scheme and logged.
Classification and enzymes are taught early and forgotten by the mock.

contentBlocks.heading: What should IGCSE Biology progress look like after six weeks?
contentBlocks.body:
After six weeks you should see three things, and a grade is not one of them. Written answers getting longer in the right way, with separate marking points instead of one fluent sentence. An error log with entries in it and, more to the point, entries crossed off. And a student who can name what they do not know, which sounds like a small thing and is not.

Grades move later, usually across a term, and they move unevenly because any paper samples the syllabus. A student can improve genuinely and score lower on the next mock because that paper leaned on the two topics they had not reached yet. No tutor can guarantee a grade, and anyone offering one is telling you something useful about themselves. Good IGCSE Biology tutors in India show you the evidence rather than the promise.

The topics that sink students are predictable, and they are almost always the ones left until last. Inheritance is the worst: monohybrid crosses, Punnett squares, the language of dominant, recessive, genotype and phenotype, and the pedigree question that looks calm and is not. Excretion in humans comes second, because the kidney is asked as structure and function together. Coordination and response is third, wide enough to be three topics on its own, holding the eye, the reflex arc, hormones and homeostasis inside one heading. Then come variation and selection, human influences on ecosystems, and biotechnology and genetic modification, which sit at the end of the book, get taught in a rush, and carry some of the most gettable marks in the paper once the definitions are secure.

An honest limit. If you start in January of Grade 10 for a February/March series, a tutor can triage and no more: pick the topics with the best marks per hour, secure the definitions and the standard diagrams, drill the alternative-to-practical skills, and leave the rest alone. Starting in Grade 9 is a completely different exercise, and a far cheaper one.
items: Longer answers with separate marking points, within roughly six weeks.
An error log with entries crossed off, not merely added.
Inheritance, excretion and coordination are the usual late-stage failures.
Mock scores move unevenly because each paper samples different topics.
Starting in January of Grade 10 means triage, not full coverage.

contentBlocks.heading: Starting home tuition for 0610 or 4BI1 Biology in India
contentBlocks.body:
Before the first session, put three things on the table: the last marked Biology script with the teacher's comments still on it, the school's topic sequence for the year, and written confirmation of the board, tier and practical component the cohort is entered for. Ten minutes of preparation saves a fortnight of guessing.

The first session should not really be a lesson. It should be a diagnosis: a short timed section of a past paper, marked in front of the student, followed by an honest conversation about what those marks show. Expect the tutor to leave with a list of topics in priority order rather than a syllabus copied off the internet. The hour that follows in every later week has a shape worth insisting on, and it is set out in the list below.

Homework between sessions should be small and specific: one past-paper section, two definitions, one diagram from memory. An hour of vague revision is worth less than fifteen focused minutes, and a Grade 10 week in an Indian school has very little slack left in it anyway.

To begin, send a query or book a free consultation. IB Gram will ask about the board, the syllabus, the level, the school calendar, your locality and the evenings you can genuinely hold, then shortlist verified profiles that match those needs. A demo or trial session can be arranged before you commit, lessons run at home, online or hybrid depending on what the week allows, and if the match is wrong you can ask for a different one. Availability depends on the level, the locality and your schedule, so name your preferred slot early. Families who attach the marked script to the first message get a sharper shortlist, because IGCSE Biology tutors in India can then see the problem before the call rather than after it.
items: 1. Five minutes: last week's error log, corrected aloud from memory.
2. Ten minutes: the week's definitions written out and checked word by word.
3. Twenty minutes: new content taught, with one labelled diagram drawn by the student.
4. Fifteen minutes: a timed past-paper section on an older topic.
5. Ten minutes: marking against the mark scheme, with missed points named.
6. Homework set: one paper section, two definitions, one diagram.

faqs.question: Will a home tutor come to our flat in Powai for a weekday evening Biology session?
faqs.answer: Usually yes, subject to tutor availability and the slot you need. Weekday evening slots in Powai fill first, because that is when every Grade 10 student is free, and a tutor who lives on the same side of the city will hold the slot far more reliably than one crossing the Mumbai Metropolitan Region in evening traffic. Tell us your preferred day and time in the first message, leave the tutor's name at the society gate in advance, and keep a table with a hard surface free, because Biology sessions involve a great deal of drawing.

faqs.question: How many home tuition sessions a week does IGCSE Biology really need?
faqs.answer: For most students, one a week in Grade 9 and two a week in Grade 10. Grade 9 is about building the habit: definitions learned properly, standard diagrams drawn from memory, one past-paper section a week. Grade 10 needs the second session because the coverage track and the return track have to run at the same time, and a single hour cannot hold both. Three sessions a week is rarely worth it. At that point the limit is the student's own study time between lessons, not the amount of teaching.

faqs.question: My daughter understands Biology but keeps losing marks. What is going wrong?
faqs.answer: Almost always the writing rather than the biology. Theory carries 50% of the marks at Cambridge IGCSE, and theory answers are marked against separate marking points. A student who writes one fluent sentence about gas exchange where the scheme wants four distinct points scores one mark out of four. The fix is mechanical. Read a mark scheme with her, count the points on the page, then rewrite the same answer as that many short statements. Two or three weeks of this shifts scores more than another month of reading the textbook.

faqs.question: How do you revise twenty-one topics in the months before the exam series?
faqs.answer: By ranking them, not by starting at page one. List every topic and mark it red, amber or green from the last two mocks. Red topics get taught again and then tested. Amber topics get a timed past-paper section and a definition check. Green topics get one section each and nothing more. Work in order of marks available per hour, which usually pushes inheritance, excretion in humans, coordination and response, and human influences on ecosystems towards the front. Revisiting everything equally is exactly how students run out of February.

faqs.question: Can the practical paper be prepared for at home without a school laboratory?
faqs.answer: Most of it, yes. Paper 6, the alternative to practical, tests skills needing no apparatus at all: identifying variables, completing a results table with correct units, plotting and interpreting a graph, spotting anomalies, naming sources of error and suggesting improvements that would actually work. A home tutor can build every one of those at the dining table from past-paper questions. Paper 5 is different, because it is a practical test with real apparatus, and handling equipment under time has to be practised in the school laboratory. Confirm with the coordinator which one your child sits.

faqs.question: Is Cambridge 0610 harder than Pearson Edexcel International GCSE Biology 4BI1?
faqs.answer: They are different rather than ranked, and your school has already chosen, so the practical question is what each one demands. Cambridge 0610 is tiered: Core caps at grade C and Extended reaches A*, so the tier decision shapes the whole two years. Edexcel 4BI1 is untiered and graded 9-1, with practical skills assessed inside the written papers rather than as a separate component. A tutor who has taught only one of them must read the other's past papers properly before starting, and you are entitled to ask whether they have.

faqs.question: Should my son be entered for Core or Extended Biology?
faqs.answer: Decide it from marked Extended past-paper sections rather than from a feeling. The school makes the entry decision, but you can bring evidence to that conversation, and a tutor can produce it inside about six weeks: three or four Extended sections done under time and marked against the scheme. Core is a narrower syllabus with a ceiling at grade C, which matters if the Class 11 or Diploma Programme plan needs a strong science result. The decision should be revisited each term instead of being settled once in Grade 9.

faqs.question: Does online Biology tutoring work as well as a tutor sitting in the room?
faqs.answer: For explanation and question practice, yes. For diagrams and handwriting, not quite. A shared screen is an excellent place to read a mark scheme line by line, and an online tutor can annotate a past paper live while the student watches. What online misses is the small physical habit: a label line that does not touch the structure, working crammed into a margin, a sketch drawn in a hurry. The usual compromise is hybrid, with one home session each week for written work and diagrams and the rest online.

faqs.question: We live in Kochi and cannot find a nearby IGCSE Biology tutor. What are the options?
faqs.answer: Widen the search online, and keep the local option for what it does best. Outside the metros, in cities like Kochi, Thiruvananthapuram, Coimbatore, Mysuru or Visakhapatnam, the pool of tutors who have genuinely taught 0610 or 4BI1 is small, and a general Biology tutor working from a state-board textbook will not cover the same ground. An online specialist from Bengaluru or the Mumbai Metropolitan Region can teach the syllabus, while a nearby tutor supervises timed written practice in person. That combination usually beats either option on its own.

faqs.question: When should past papers start, and where do we get IGCSE Biology past papers help?
faqs.answer: Start single sections in Grade 9 and whole papers from around the first mock in Grade 10. A full paper attempted before the topics are taught teaches nothing except discouragement, which is why section-by-section practice works better early on. Ask the school for the papers it uses and the mark schemes that go with them, since most subject teachers will share both. The value sits in the marking, not the attempting. A script written and never checked against the scheme is an hour spent for almost nothing.

faqs.question: There has been no visible progress after a month. What should we do?
faqs.answer: Ask for the evidence before changing anything. A month is four or five sessions, which is enough to fix definitions and diagrams but not enough to move a mock score. Ask the tutor for the error log, the marked scripts and a one-paragraph account of what has changed. If the log is empty and the sessions have been re-explanations of last week's class, that is a real problem and you should ask for a different match. If the log is full and the scores simply have not moved yet, give it another six weeks.

heroTitle: Four English syllabuses, one confusing choice in India
heroSubtitle: English at IGCSE is not one subject. A Grade 9 student in Bandra may be entered for First Language English 0500 while a classmate down the corridor sits English as a Second Language 0511, and the two are prepared in completely different ways. A home tutor should name the code before the first lesson.
introSummary: IGCSE English tutors in India work across four different syllabuses, and the home tutor you book should be able to name the one your child is entered for before the first lesson. Cambridge International Education runs First Language English 0500, English as a Second Language 0510 and 0511, and Literature in English 0475. Pearson Edexcel runs English Language A (4EA1), English Language B (4EB1) and English as a Second Language (4ES1). These are separate courses with separate papers, not easy and hard versions of one subject, and a tutor who treats them as interchangeable will teach the wrong thing well. This page sets out what each syllabus assesses, why 0511 changes preparation by counting speaking, how home tuition is arranged across Indian cities, and how a student lands in the wrong English syllabus in the first place.

contentBlocks.heading: Naming the syllabus first: how a 0500, 0510, 0511 or 0475 match runs in India
contentBlocks.body:
A parent writes in saying the child needs English help before the Grade 10 mocks. That sentence is not yet a brief. English at IGCSE splits into several syllabuses with different papers, so the first thing IB Gram asks is which code the school has entered the student for: First Language English 0500, English as a Second Language 0510 or 0511, Literature in English 0475, or one of the Pearson Edexcel codes. If you do not know, that is normal and easily settled, and the school office or the head of English will confirm it in a line.

Once the code is known the rest of the intake is quick. We ask for the board and the exam series the student is aiming at, the level or tier the school has indicated, the school calendar with coursework and mock dates marked on it, your locality, and the evenings that are genuinely free after school and activities. Families looking for IGCSE English tutors in India usually have one or two workable slots a week, not five, and a plan built on imaginary time collapses by the third week. A home tutor who cannot reach you by seven in the evening is not really an option, whatever the profile says.

Then we shortlist. Profiles are checked before they go live, and the list is filtered to tutors who have taught the named syllabus rather than English in general. You get a short list, not a long one, because comparing nine profiles for a Grade 9 student is a way of postponing the decision. A demo or trial session can be arranged before you commit, and the most useful thing you can hand that tutor is a marked script.

If the fit is wrong after the trial, or after a few weeks, ask for a different match. Nobody reads a tutor correctly from a profile every time, and a student who has stopped talking in the session is telling you something. Home, online and hybrid are all available, subject to tutor availability in your locality.
items: 1. Confirm the code with the school: 0500, 0510, 0511, 0475 or an Edexcel code
2. Send the exam series, the tier and any coursework deadlines the school has set
3. Share your locality and the two evenings that are genuinely free each week
4. Review a short list of verified profiles that have taught that exact syllabus
5. Run a trial session built around one marked script, then decide

contentBlocks.heading: Which English syllabus is your child actually sitting: 0500, 0510, 0511 or 4EA1?
contentBlocks.body:
Ask the school office for the code printed against English on the statement of entry and you will have the answer in a day: 0500 is First Language English, 0510 and 0511 are English as a Second Language, 0475 is Literature in English, and 4EA1, 4EB1 and 4ES1 are the Pearson Edexcel routes. That single line settles more arguments than any diagnostic test.

IGCSE in India means Cambridge IGCSE, from Cambridge International Education, or Pearson Edexcel International GCSE, and it usually runs as a two-year course across Grades 9 and 10 before the student moves into the International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma Programme (DP), Cambridge International AS and A Levels, or across to CBSE or ISC in Class 11. The two boards do not label English the same way, so a parent comparing notes with a friend at another school is often comparing two different qualifications and reaching a confident wrong conclusion.

Grading differs as well. Cambridge grades most syllabuses A* to G, and some syllabuses have 9 to 1 versions under different codes, while Edexcel International GCSE grades 9 to 1. Many Cambridge subjects are also split into Core and Extended tiers, where Core tops out at grade C and Extended reaches A*. Whether a tier applies to your child's English entry is a question for the coordinator rather than for a tutor guessing from a report card, and it is worth asking in writing so that the answer is on record.

One more distinction families miss: a language syllabus and Literature in English are separate entries. A student can sit 0500 and 0475 together, or 0500 on its own, and the workload of those two choices is not comparable. If the school has entered your child for both, the reading at home roughly doubles, and a home tutor planning one session a week has to decide, openly with you, which of the two that session serves.
items: 0500: Cambridge IGCSE First Language English, for students working in English as a first language
0510 and 0511: Cambridge IGCSE English as a Second Language, with listening assessed
0475: Cambridge IGCSE Literature in English, entered alongside a language syllabus or alone
4EA1, 4EB1 and 4ES1: the Pearson Edexcel International GCSE English routes
Cambridge grades most syllabuses A* to G; Edexcel International GCSE grades 9 to 1

contentBlocks.heading: 0500, 0510, 0511 and 0475: the four English syllabuses in India
contentBlocks.body:
Start with 0500. Cambridge IGCSE First Language English is assessed through a reading paper, and then through directed writing and composition, which a school may instead cover with a coursework portfolio. Those are two very different experiences for a student. The reading paper rewards a child who can find evidence in an unfamiliar passage, quote it economically and answer the question actually asked rather than writing down everything they noticed. Directed writing asks the student to move material from one form into another with a purpose and an audience held in mind. Composition asks for sustained writing of the student's own. A child who writes beautifully and reads carelessly loses marks on the first and gains them on the second, which is exactly why a tutor should see a marked script before deciding what a term contains.

English as a Second Language is a different qualification, not an easier version of 0500. Codes 0510 and 0511 assess reading and writing plus listening, and the difference between them is speaking: 0511 counts speaking into the grade, while 0510 reports speaking separately. A student who has been coasting on written accuracy feels that difference immediately. Listening also responds quickly to practice, and it is often the cheapest improvement available in the first month of home tuition.

Literature in English 0475 is the reading-heavy option. The set texts are chosen by the school, and the volume of reading is the part families underestimate. A student who has not finished the texts cannot be taught essay structure usefully, because there is nothing yet to structure. Ask for the text list at the start of Grade 9, not in the last term.

Pearson Edexcel divides the same ground differently, with English Language A (4EA1), English Language B (4EB1) and English as a Second Language (4ES1). If your school teaches the Edexcel route, a tutor who knows only the Cambridge codes will be rebuilding their materials while your child waits.
